local ESP_KINDS = { "Aura", "Box", "Tracer", "Avatar", "Timer" }

local ESP_BINDINGS = {
    ["Aura"]   = { key = "_VynxAuraESP",          setter = "AuraESP" },
    ["Box"]    = { key = "_VynxBoxedESP",         setter = "BoxedESP" },
    ["Tracer"] = { key = "_VynxShowTracker",      setter = "ShowTracker" },
    ["Avatar"] = { key = "_VynxAvatarESP",        setter = "AvatarESP" },
    ["Timer"]  = { key = "_VynxRagdollCountdown", setter = "RagdollCountdown" },
}

local function espKindOn(kind)
    local b = ESP_BINDINGS[kind]
    return b ~= nil and _G[b.key] == true
end

local function setESPKind(kind, on)
    local b = ESP_BINDINGS[kind]
    if not b then return end
    _G[b.key] = on and true or false
    if kind == "Avatar" and _G._GhostccSetAvatarESP then
        pcall(_G._GhostccSetAvatarESP, _G[b.key])
    end
    if kind == "Aura" and _G._AdaptESPSetEnabled then
        pcall(_G._AdaptESPSetEnabled, _G[b.key])
    end
    if VisualSetters[b.setter] then pcall(VisualSetters[b.setter], _G[b.key]) end
    if _G.KRIXSaveNow then pcall(_G.KRIXSaveNow) end
end

local function anyESPOn()
    for _, kind in ipairs(ESP_KINDS) do
        if espKindOn(kind) then return true end
    end
    return false
end

local espSel = {}

local function anySelected()
    for _, kind in ipairs(ESP_KINDS) do
        if espSel[kind] then return true end
    end
    return false
end

local function espSelSave()
    local list = {}
    for _, kind in ipairs(ESP_KINDS) do
        if espSel[kind] then list[#list + 1] = kind end
    end
    _G._VynxESPSelection = table.concat(list, ",")
end

local function espSelLoad()
    for _, kind in ipairs(ESP_KINDS) do espSel[kind] = nil end
    local raw = _G._VynxESPSelection
    if type(raw) == "string" and raw ~= "" then
        for kind in string.gmatch(raw, "[^,]+") do
            if ESP_BINDINGS[kind] then espSel[kind] = true end
        end
    elseif type(raw) ~= "string" then
        for _, kind in ipairs(ESP_KINDS) do
            if espKindOn(kind) then espSel[kind] = true end
        end
        espSelSave()
    end
end
espSelLoad()
if _G._VynxESPOn == nil then _G._VynxESPOn = anyESPOn() end

    applyingESP = true
    for _, kind in ipairs(ESP_KINDS) do
        setESPKind(kind, _G._VynxESPOn and espSel[kind] or false)
    end
    applyingESP = false
    espSelSave()
    refreshESPOptions()
end

local function resolveKb(name)
	if not name or name == "" or name == "None" then return nil end
	local ok, val = pcall(function() return Enum.KeyCode[name] end)
	return (ok and val) or nil
end

local function saveConfig()
	local ok, encoded = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONEncode(cfg) end)
	if ok and encoded and writefile then
		pcall(writefile, CONFIG_FILE, encoded)
	end
end

local function loadConfig()
	if not (isfile and readfile and isfile(CONFIG_FILE)) then return end
	local ok, data = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(readfile(CONFIG_FILE)) end)
	if not ok or type(data) ~= "table" then return end

	cfg.power        = tonumber(data.power) or DEFAULT_CFG.power
	cfg.interval     = tonumber(data.interval) or DEFAULT_CFG.interval
	cfg.keybindKb    = type(data.keybindKb) == "string" and data.keybindKb or DEFAULT_CFG.keybindKb
	cfg.keybindGp    = type(data.keybindGp) == "string" and data.keybindGp or DEFAULT_CFG.keybindGp
	if type(data.autoBrainrot) == "boolean" then cfg.autoBrainrot = data.autoBrainrot end
	cfg.backgroundId = type(data.backgroundId) == "string" and data.backgroundId or DEFAULT_CFG.backgroundId
	cfg.strength     = type(data.strength) == "string" and data.strength or DEFAULT_CFG.strength
	cfg.mode         = type(data.mode) == "string" and data.mode or DEFAULT_CFG.mode
	cfg.locked       = data.locked == true
end

local function tw(obj, props, t, style)
	TweenService:Create(
		obj,
		TweenInfo.new(t or 0.16, style or Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
		props
	):Play()
end

local function corner(parent, r)
	local c = Instance.new("UICorner", parent)
	c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, r or 10)
	return c
end

local function stroke(parent, color, thickness, transparency)
	local s = Instance.new("UIStroke", parent)
	s.Color = color or C.edge
	s.Thickness = thickness or 1
	s.Transparency = transparency or 0
	s.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
	return s
end

local function makeDraggable(frame)
	local dragging, dragStart, startPos
	frame.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
		if cfg.locked then return end
		if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
			or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			dragging = true
			dragStart = i.Position
			startPos = frame.Position
			i.Changed:Connect(function()
				if i.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then dragging = false end
			end)
		end
	end)
	frame.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
		if dragging and not cfg.locked and (i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
			or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
			local d = i.Position - dragStart
			frame.Position = UDim2.new(
				startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + d.X,
				startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + d.Y
			)
		end
	end)
end

local function isGamepad(kc)
	local n = kc.Name
	return n:sub(1, 6) == "Button" or n:sub(1, 10) == "Thumbstick"
		or n:sub(1, 4) == "DPad" or n == "ButtonSelect" or n == "ButtonStart"
end

local function applyBackground(id, targets)
	cfg.backgroundId = tostring(id or "")
	for _, img in ipairs(targets) do
		if cfg.backgroundId == "" then
			img.Image = ""
			img.Visible = false
		else
			img.Image = "rbxassetid://" .. cfg.backgroundId
			img.Visible = true
		end
	end
end

local function paintLock(animate)
	local on = cfg.locked == true
	lockBtn.Text = on and "🔒" or "🔓"
	lockBtn.TextColor3 = on and Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0) or C.dim
	local bg = on and C.accent or C.card
	if animate then tw(lockBtn, { BackgroundColor3 = bg }) else lockBtn.BackgroundColor3 = bg end
end
paintLock(false)

lockBtn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
	if not cfg.locked then tw(lockBtn, { BackgroundColor3 = C.card2 }) end
end)
lockBtn.MouseLeave:Connect(function() paintLock(true) end)
lockBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	cfg.locked = not cfg.locked
	paintLock(true)
	saveConfig()
end)

-- Input row
local function mkInputRow(yPos, labelText, getValue, onConfirm)
	local row = Instance.new("Frame", settingsFrame)
	row.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 36)
	row.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, yPos)
	row.BackgroundColor3 = C.card
	row.BorderSizePixel = 0
	row.ZIndex = 22
	corner(row, 10)
	stroke(row, C.edge, 1, 0.25)

	local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel", row)
	lbl.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, 0)
	lbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 0)
	lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	lbl.Text = labelText
	lbl.TextColor3 = C.white
	lbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	lbl.TextSize = 11
	lbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	lbl.ZIndex = 23

	local box = Instance.new("TextBox", row)
	box.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(68, 24)
	box.Position = UDim2.new(1, -78, 0.5, -12)
	box.BackgroundColor3 = C.inputBg
	box.BorderSizePixel = 0
	box.Text = tostring(getValue())
	box.TextColor3 = C.accent
	box.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	box.TextSize = 11
	box.ClearTextOnFocus = false
	box.ZIndex = 24
	corner(box, 7)
	local bs = stroke(box, C.accent, 1, 0.55)

	box.Focused:Connect(function()
		tw(bs, { Transparency = 0.1 })
	end)
	box.FocusLost:Connect(function()
		tw(bs, { Transparency = 0.55 })
		local n = tonumber(box.Text)
		if n then
			onConfirm(n)
			box.Text = tostring(getValue())
			saveConfig()
		else
			box.Text = tostring(getValue())
		end
	end)
	return box
end

local kbBindBtn, gpBindBtn

local function updateKbLabels()
	if kbBindBtn then
		if listeningFor == "kb" then
			kbBindBtn.Text = "..."
			kbBindBtn.TextColor3 = C.waiting
		else
			kbBindBtn.Text = cfg.keybindKb ~= "" and cfg.keybindKb or "None"
			kbBindBtn.TextColor3 = C.accent
		end
	end
	if gpBindBtn then
		if listeningFor == "gp" then
			gpBindBtn.Text = "..."
			gpBindBtn.TextColor3 = C.waiting
		else
			gpBindBtn.Text = cfg.keybindGp ~= "" and cfg.keybindGp or "None"
			gpBindBtn.TextColor3 = C.accent
		end
	end
end

local function mkKeybindRow(yPos, labelText, which)
	local row = Instance.new("Frame", settingsFrame)
	row.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 36)
	row.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, yPos)
	row.BackgroundColor3 = C.card
	row.BorderSizePixel = 0
	row.ZIndex = 22
	corner(row, 10)
	stroke(row, C.edge, 1, 0.25)

	local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel", row)
	lbl.Size = UDim2.new(0.4, 0, 1, 0)
	lbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 0)
	lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	lbl.Text = labelText
	lbl.TextColor3 = C.white
	lbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	lbl.TextSize = 11
	lbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	lbl.ZIndex = 23

	local bindBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", row)
	bindBtn.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(78, 24)
	bindBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -112, 0.5, -12)
	bindBtn.BackgroundColor3 = C.inputBg
	bindBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
	bindBtn.AutoButtonColor = false
	bindBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	bindBtn.TextSize = 10
	bindBtn.TextColor3 = C.accent
	bindBtn.ZIndex = 24
	bindBtn.Text = which == "kb" and cfg.keybindKb or cfg.keybindGp
	corner(bindBtn, 7)
	local bStr = stroke(bindBtn, C.accent, 1, 0.55)

	bindBtn.MouseEnter:Connect(function() tw(bStr, { Transparency = 0.1 }) end)
	bindBtn.MouseLeave:Connect(function() tw(bStr, { Transparency = 0.55 }) end)
	bindBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		listeningFor = (listeningFor == which) and nil or which
		updateKbLabels()
	end)

	local clearBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", row)
	clearBtn.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(24, 24)
	clearBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0.5, -12)
	clearBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(36, 18, 22)
	clearBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
	clearBtn.AutoButtonColor = false
	clearBtn.Text = "X"
	clearBtn.TextColor3 = C.red
	clearBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
	clearBtn.TextSize = 12
	clearBtn.ZIndex = 24
	corner(clearBtn, 7)

	clearBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		if listeningFor == which then listeningFor = nil end
		if which == "kb" then cfg.keybindKb = "None" else cfg.keybindGp = "None" end
		updateKbLabels()
		saveConfig()
	end)

	if which == "kb" then kbBindBtn = bindBtn end
	if which == "gp" then gpBindBtn = bindBtn end
	return bindBtn
end

	local row = Instance.new("Frame", settingsFrame)
	row.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 36)

	row.BackgroundColor3 = C.card
	row.BorderSizePixel = 0

	local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel", row)
	lbl.Size = UDim2.new(0.42, 0, 1, 0)
	lbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 0)
	lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	lbl.Text = "Strength"
	lbl.TextColor3 = C.white
	lbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	lbl.TextSize = 11
	lbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	lbl.ZIndex = 23

	local prevBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", row)
	prevBtn.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(22, 24)
	prevBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -172, 0.5, -12)
	prevBtn.BackgroundColor3 = C.inputBg
	prevBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
	prevBtn.AutoButtonColor = false
	prevBtn.Text = "<"
	prevBtn.TextColor3 = C.accent
	prevBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
	prevBtn.TextSize = 12
	prevBtn.ZIndex = 24
	corner(prevBtn, 7)
	local ps = stroke(prevBtn, C.accent, 1, 0.55)
	prevBtn.MouseEnter:Connect(function() tw(ps, { Transparency = 0.1 }) end)
	prevBtn.MouseLeave:Connect(function() tw(ps, { Transparency = 0.55 }) end)

	local cycleBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", row)
	cycleBtn.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(106, 24)
	cycleBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -148, 0.5, -12)
	cycleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = C.inputBg
	cycleBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
	cycleBtn.AutoButtonColor = false
	cycleBtn.Text = getStrengthLabel()
	cycleBtn.TextColor3 = C.accent
	cycleBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	cycleBtn.TextSize = 10
	cycleBtn.ZIndex = 24
	corner(cycleBtn, 7)
	local cs = stroke(cycleBtn, C.accent, 1, 0.55)
	cycleBtn.MouseEnter:Connect(function() tw(cs, { Transparency = 0.1 }) end)
	cycleBtn.MouseLeave:Connect(function() tw(cs, { Transparency = 0.55 }) end)

	local nextBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", row)
	nextBtn.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(22, 24)
	nextBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0.5, -12)
	nextBtn.BackgroundColor3 = C.inputBg
	nextBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
	nextBtn.AutoButtonColor = false
	nextBtn.Text = ">"
	nextBtn.TextColor3 = C.accent
	nextBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
	nextBtn.TextSize = 12
	nextBtn.ZIndex = 24
	corner(nextBtn, 7)
	local ns = stroke(nextBtn, C.accent, 1, 0.55)
	nextBtn.MouseEnter:Connect(function() tw(ns, { Transparency = 0.1 }) end)
	nextBtn.MouseLeave:Connect(function() tw(ns, { Transparency = 0.55 }) end)

	local function currentIndex()
		for i, o in ipairs(STRENGTH_OPTIONS) do
			if o.key == cfg.strength then return i end
		end
		return 4
	end

	local function apply()
		local preset = STRENGTH_OPTIONS[currentIndex()]
		cfg.strength = preset.key
		cycleBtn.Text = preset.label
		saveConfig()
	end

	prevBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		local i = currentIndex() - 1
		if i < 1 then i = #STRENGTH_OPTIONS end
		cfg.strength = STRENGTH_OPTIONS[i].key
		apply()
	end)

	nextBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		local i = currentIndex() + 1
		if i > #STRENGTH_OPTIONS then i = 1 end
		cfg.strength = STRENGTH_OPTIONS[i].key
		apply()
	end)

	cycleBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		local i = currentIndex() + 1
		if i > #STRENGTH_OPTIONS then i = 1 end
		cfg.strength = STRENGTH_OPTIONS[i].key
		apply()
	end)

	strengthBtn = cycleBtn
	return cycleBtn
end

-- V1 / V2 mode picker
local v1Btn, v2Btn

local function createModeRow(yPos)
	local row = Instance.new("Frame", settingsFrame)
	row.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 36)
	row.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, yPos)
	row.BackgroundColor3 = C.card
	row.BorderSizePixel = 0
	row.ZIndex = 22
	corner(row, 10)
	stroke(row, C.edge, 1, 0.25)

	local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel", row)
	lbl.Size = UDim2.new(0.42, 0, 1, 0)
	lbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 0)
	lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	lbl.Text = "Mode"
	lbl.TextColor3 = C.white
	lbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	lbl.TextSize = 11
	lbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	lbl.ZIndex = 23

	local function makeModeBtn(text, key, xPos)
		local b = Instance.new("TextButton", row)
		b.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(64, 24)
		b.Position = UDim2.new(1, xPos, 0.5, -12)
		b.BackgroundColor3 = C.inputBg
		b.BorderSizePixel = 0
		b.AutoButtonColor = false
		b.Text = text
		b.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
		b.TextSize = 11
		b.ZIndex = 24
		corner(b, 7)
		stroke(b, C.edge, 1, 0.3)

		b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			cfg.mode = key
			saveConfig()
			local on1 = cfg.mode == "v1"
			local on2 = cfg.mode == "v2"
			if v1Btn then
				v1Btn.BackgroundColor3 = on1 and C.accent or C.inputBg
				v1Btn.TextColor3 = on1 and Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0) or C.accent
			end
			if v2Btn then
				v2Btn.BackgroundColor3 = on2 and C.accent or C.inputBg
				v2Btn.TextColor3 = on2 and Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0) or C.accent
			end
		end)

		return b
	end

	v1Btn = makeModeBtn("V1", "v1", -142)
	v2Btn = makeModeBtn("V2", "v2", -74)
	return v1Btn, v2Btn
end

local function refreshModeButtons()
	local on1 = cfg.mode == "v1"
	local on2 = cfg.mode == "v2"
	if v1Btn then
		v1Btn.BackgroundColor3 = on1 and C.accent or C.inputBg
		v1Btn.TextColor3 = on1 and Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0) or C.accent
	end
	if v2Btn then
		v2Btn.BackgroundColor3 = on2 and C.accent or C.inputBg
		v2Btn.TextColor3 = on2 and Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0) or C.accent
	end
end

-- Background picker row
local function createBackgroundRow(yPos)
	local row = Instance.new("Frame", settingsFrame)
	row.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 72)
	row.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, yPos)
	row.BackgroundColor3 = C.card
	row.BorderSizePixel = 0
	row.ZIndex = 22
	corner(row, 10)
	stroke(row, C.edge, 1, 0.25)

	local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel", row)
	lbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 16)
	lbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 6)
	lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	lbl.Text = "Background"
	lbl.TextColor3 = C.white
	lbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	lbl.TextSize = 11
	lbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	lbl.ZIndex = 23

	local strip = Instance.new("Frame", row)
	strip.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 40)
	strip.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 26)
	strip.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	strip.ZIndex = 23

	local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout", strip)
	layout.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
	layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 6)
	layout.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center

	local refs = {}

	local function refresh()
		for _, r in ipairs(refs) do
			local on = r.id == (cfg.backgroundId or "")
			r.stroke.Color = on and C.accent or C.edge
			r.stroke.Thickness = on and 1.6 or 1
		end
	end

	for _, opt in ipairs(BG_OPTIONS) do
		local btn = Instance.new("TextButton", strip)
		btn.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(38, 36)
		btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(10, 10, 12)
		btn.BorderSizePixel = 0
		btn.AutoButtonColor = false
		btn.Text = ""
		btn.ZIndex = 24
		corner(btn, 8)
		local st = stroke(btn, C.edge, 1, 0)

		if opt.id ~= "" then
			local thumb = Instance.new("ImageLabel", btn)
			thumb.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
			thumb.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			thumb.Image = "rbxassetid://" .. opt.id
			thumb.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Crop
			thumb.ZIndex = 24
			corner(thumb, 8)
		else
			local off = Instance.new("TextLabel", btn)
			off.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
			off.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			off.Text = "Off"
			off.TextColor3 = C.dim
			off.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
			off.TextSize = 10
			off.ZIndex = 25
		end

		btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			applyBackground(opt.id, { mainBg, setBg })
			refresh()
			saveConfig()
		end)

		refs[#refs + 1] = { id = opt.id, stroke = st }
	end

	refresh()
	return refresh
end

-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
-- PING LAGGER LOGIC
-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
local function findRemote()
	local rrs = game:FindFirstChild("RobloxReplicatedStorage")
	if not rrs then return nil end
	local found
	for _, name in ipairs({ "SetPlayerBlockList", "UpdatePlayerBlockList", "SetBlockList", "UpdateBlockList" }) do
		local r = rrs:FindFirstChild(name)
		if r and r:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
			found = r
			break
		end
	end
	if not found then
		for _, c in ipairs(rrs:GetChildren()) do
			if c:IsA("RemoteEvent") and c.Name:find("Block") then
				found = c
				break
			end
		end
	end
	return found
end

remote = findRemote()

local function buildPayload(power, depth, scale)
	depth = depth or 186
	scale = scale or 1.0

	local main = {}
	local nested = { {} }
	local current = nested[1]
	for _ = 1, depth do
		local n = {}
		table.insert(current, n)
		current = n
	end

	local baseRep = math.floor(power / 188)
	local maxRep  = math.floor(baseRep * scale)
	maxRep = math.min(maxRep, math.floor(10000 * scale))
	maxRep = math.max(maxRep, 1)

	for _ = 1, maxRep do
		table.insert(main, nested)
	end
	return main
end

-- ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- V1: Safer & smoother
--   • Reacts to errors — backs off when a fire fails
--   • Ramps delay downward on success (down to 0.05s) → less delay overall
--   • Works with Auto Brainrot
--   • Payload uses the raw strength scale
-- ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- V2: Aggressive
--   • No backoff — keeps firing at exactly cfg.interval no matter what
--   • Payload amplified (strength scale × V2 boost)
--   • More delay per cycle, and can lag hard if spammed
-- ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
local V2_PAYLOAD_BOOST = 1.35

local function runPingLoop()
	if cfg.mode == "v2" then
		while active and remote do
			local preset = getStrengthPreset()
			local payload = buildPayload(cfg.power, preset.depth, preset.scale * V2_PAYLOAD_BOOST)
			pcall(function()
				remote:FireServer(payload)
			end)
			task.wait(cfg.interval)
		end
	else
		local delay = cfg.interval
		while active and remote do
			local preset = getStrengthPreset()
			local payload = buildPayload(cfg.power, preset.depth, preset.scale)
			local ok = pcall(function()
				remote:FireServer(payload)
			end)
			if not ok then
				delay = math.min(delay * 1.5, 0.5)
			else
				delay = math.max(delay * 0.995, 0.05)
			end
			task.wait(delay)
		end
	end
end

local function flipLag(state, isManual)
	active = state

	if isManual then
		if brainrotMode then
			manualOverride = not state
		else
			manualOverride = false
		end
	end

	if active then
		if not remote then
			remote = findRemote()
			if not remote then
				active = false
				flipLag(false)
				return
			end
		end
		activateBtn.BackgroundColor3 = C.accent
		activateLbl.Text = "ACTIVATED"
		activateLbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
		activateStroke.Color = C.white
		activateStroke.Transparency = 0.15
		statusLbl.Text = cfg.mode == "v2" and "ON·V2" or "ON"
		statusLbl.TextColor3 = C.green
		tw(statusPill, { BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(16, 36, 22) }, 0.18)
		task.spawn(runPingLoop)
	else
		activateBtn.BackgroundColor3 = C.card
		activateLbl.Text = "ACTIVATE"
		activateLbl.TextColor3 = C.white
		activateStroke.Color = C.accent
		activateStroke.Transparency = 0.45
		statusLbl.Text = "OFF"
		statusLbl.TextColor3 = C.red
		tw(statusPill, { BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(22, 14, 28) }, 0.18)
	end
end

activateBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	flipLag(not active, true)
end)

-- Auto Brainrot (only triggers when WalkSpeed is in 10-25 range, same as Hyeju)
local AUTO_MIN_WS = 10
local AUTO_MAX_WS = 25

_conns[#_conns + 1] = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
	if not panelOpen then return end
	if not cfg.autoBrainrot then
		if brainrotMode then
			brainrotMode = false
			lastBrainrotState = false
		end
		return
	end

	local char = plr.Character
	if not char then return end
	local hum = char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
	if not hum then return end

	local ws = hum.WalkSpeed
	local hasBrainrot = ws >= AUTO_MIN_WS and ws <= AUTO_MAX_WS

	if hasBrainrot and not lastBrainrotState then
		brainrotMode = true
		lastBrainrotState = true
		manualOverride = false
		flipLag(true)
	elseif not hasBrainrot and lastBrainrotState then
		brainrotMode = false
		lastBrainrotState = false
		manualOverride = false
		flipLag(false)
	end
end)

-- Input
_conns[#_conns + 1] = UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
	local kc = input.KeyCode
	if kc == Enum.KeyCode.Unknown then return end

	local isGp = isGamepad(kc)
	local isKb = input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard

	if listeningFor then
		if kc == Enum.KeyCode.Escape then
			listeningFor = nil
			updateKbLabels()
			return
		end
		if listeningFor == "kb" and isKb and not BLACKLISTED[kc] then
			cfg.keybindKb = kc.Name
			listeningFor = nil
			updateKbLabels()
			saveConfig()
			return
		end
		if listeningFor == "gp" and isGp then
			cfg.keybindGp = kc.Name
			listeningFor = nil
			updateKbLabels()
			saveConfig()
			return
		end
		return
	end

	if processed or not panelOpen then return end

	local kbEnum = resolveKb(cfg.keybindKb)
	local gpEnum = resolveKb(cfg.keybindGp)

	if (kbEnum and kc == kbEnum and isKb) or (gpEnum and kc == gpEnum and isGp) then
		flipLag(not active, true)
	end
end)

updateKbLabels()

-- Open / close API used by the Settings button
local function setOpen(on)
	on = on == true
	if panelOpen == on then return end
	panelOpen = on
	if on then
		mainFrame.Visible = true
	else
		closeSettings()
		if active then flipLag(false) end
		brainrotMode, lastBrainrotState, manualOverride = false, false, false
		mainFrame.Visible = false
	end
end

return {
	Toggle = function() setOpen(not panelOpen); return panelOpen end,
	IsOpen = function() return panelOpen end,
	SetOpen = setOpen,
	Destroy = function()
		if active then active = false end
		for _, c in ipairs(_conns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
		_conns = {}
		pcall(function() screen:Destroy() end)
	end,
}
end)()
_G._GhostccPingLaggerUIRuntime = _G._GhostccPingLaggerUI
end)

local function loadConfig()
	if isfile and isfile("ghost_antiBat_config.json") then
		local ok, data = pcall(function()
			return HttpService:JSONDecode(readfile("ghost_antiBat_config.json"))
		end)

			if type(data.Keybind) == "string" then config.Keybind = data.Keybind end
			if type(data.AntiBatEnabled) == "boolean" then config.AntiBatEnabled = data.AntiBatEnabled end
			if type(data.InfJumpEnabled) == "boolean" then config.InfJumpEnabled = data.InfJumpEnabled end
			if type(data.BackgroundId) == "string" then config.BackgroundId = data.BackgroundId end
		end
	end
end

-- Anti Bat (velocity desync)
local antiBatConn = nil
local antiBatActive = false

local function enableAntiBat()
	if antiBatConn then return end
	antiBatActive = true
	antiBatConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		if not antiBatActive then return end
		local char = LocalPlayer.Character
		if not char then return end
		local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not hrp then return end
		local vel = hrp.Velocity
		local y = vel.Y
		hrp.Velocity = Vector3.new(math.random(-4000, 4000), y, math.random(-4000, 4000))
		RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()
		if hrp then
			hrp.Velocity = vel
		end
	end)
end

local function disableAntiBat()
	antiBatActive = false
	if antiBatConn then
		antiBatConn:Disconnect()
		antiBatConn = nil
	end
end

-- Infinite Jump
local infJumpConn = nil
local infJumpActive = false
local forceJump = false

local function enableInfJump()
	if infJumpConn then return end
	infJumpActive = true
	infJumpConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		if not infJumpActive then return end
		local char = LocalPlayer.Character
		if not char then return end
		local humanoid = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not humanoid or not hrp then return end
		if humanoid.Jump or forceJump then
			local vel = hrp.Velocity
			if vel.Y < 50 then
				hrp.Velocity = Vector3.new(vel.X, 50, vel.Z)
			end
		end
	end)
end

local function disableInfJump()
	infJumpActive = false
	if infJumpConn then
		infJumpConn:Disconnect()
		infJumpConn = nil
	end
end

local function onJumping()
	if infJumpActive then
		forceJump = true
		task.wait(0.1)
		forceJump = false
	end
end

	task.wait(0.5)
	local humanoid = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if humanoid then

	end
	if infJumpActive then
		enableInfJump()
	end
end)

-- Drag
local dragging = false
local dragStart, startPos, touchIndex

local function clampPos(pos)
	local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local vs = cam and cam.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1920, 1080)
	local inset = GuiService:GetGuiInset()
	local x = math.clamp(pos.X.Offset + pos.X.Scale * vs.X, 0, math.max(0, vs.X - main.AbsoluteSize.X))
	local y = math.clamp(pos.Y.Offset + pos.Y.Scale * (vs.Y - inset.Y), 0, math.max(0, vs.Y - inset.Y - main.AbsoluteSize.Y))
	return UDim2.fromOffset(x, y)
end

main.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		dragging = true
		dragStart = input.Position
		startPos = main.Position
		touchIndex = input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch and input.UserInputIndex or nil
	end
end)

_conns[#_conns + 1] = UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
	if not dragging then return end
	local isTouch = input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
	if isTouch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
		if isTouch and touchIndex and input.UserInputIndex ~= touchIndex then return end
		local delta = input.Position - dragStart
		main.Position = clampPos(UDim2.new(
			startPos.X.Scale,
			startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
			startPos.Y.Scale,
			startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
		))
	end
end)

_conns[#_conns + 1] = UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
	if not dragging then return end
	local isTouch = input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
	if isTouch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
		if isTouch and touchIndex and input.UserInputIndex ~= touchIndex then return end
		dragging = false
		touchIndex = nil
	end
end)

	setAntiVisual(true)

	setInfVisual(true)

end

		_conns = {}
		pcall(function() screenGui:Destroy() end)
	end,
}
end)()

end)

local MIN_POWER = 60000

local DEFAULT_POWER = 100000

local function snapPower(value)
    local steps = math.floor((value - MIN_POWER) / STEP + 0.5)
    return math.clamp(MIN_POWER + steps * STEP, MIN_POWER, MAX_POWER)
end

local function snapGui(value)
    local steps = math.floor((value - MIN_GUI) / GUI_STEP + 0.5)
    return math.clamp(MIN_GUI + steps * GUI_STEP, MIN_GUI, MAX_GUI)
end

local function saveData()
    pcall(function()
        local data = {
            Mode = State.Mode,
            ModeScheme = 2,
            BackgroundIndex = State.BackgroundIndex,
            Power = State.Power,
            Keybind = State.Keybind and State.Keybind.Name or nil,
            GuiSize = State.GuiSize,
            AutoEnable = State.AutoEnable,
            Compact = State.Compact
        }
        writefile(SAVE_FILE, HttpService:JSONEncode(data))
    end)
end

local function loadData()
    if not isfile(SAVE_FILE) then return false end
    local success, data = pcall(function()
        return HttpService:JSONDecode(readfile(SAVE_FILE))
    end)
    if success and data then
        if data.ModeScheme == 2 and (data.Mode == "V1" or data.Mode == "V2") then
            State.Mode = data.Mode
        else
            State.Mode = "V1"   -- older save: the old second mode is now V1
        end
        if data.BackgroundIndex ~= nil then
            State.BackgroundIndex = math.clamp(tonumber(data.BackgroundIndex) or 1, 1, 4)
        end
        if data.Power then State.Power = snapPower(data.Power) end
        if data.Keybind then
            local key = Enum.KeyCode[data.Keybind]
            if key then State.Keybind = key end
        end
        if data.GuiSize then
            State.GuiSize = snapGui(tonumber(data.GuiSize) or DEFAULT_GUI)
        end
        if data.AutoEnable ~= nil then
            State.AutoEnable = data.AutoEnable
        end
        State.Compact = data.Compact == true
        return true
    end
    return false
end

local function formatK(value)
    return string.format("%.1fK", value / 1000)
end

local function findRemote()
    local storage = game:FindFirstChild("RobloxReplicatedStorage")
    if not storage then return nil end
    local names = {"SetPlayerBlockList", "UpdatePlayerBlockList", "SetBlockList", "UpdateBlockList"}
    for _, name in ipairs(names) do
        local r = storage:FindFirstChild(name)
        if r and r:IsA("RemoteEvent") then return r end
    end
    for _, child in ipairs(storage:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("RemoteEvent") and child.Name:find("Block") then return child end
    end
    return nil
end

local function buildPayload()
    local main = {}
    local nested = {{}}
    local current = nested[1]
    for _ = 1, 296 do
        local new = {}
        table.insert(current, new)
        current = new
    end
    local maxRep = math.min(math.floor(State.Power / 298), 10000)
    for _ = 1, maxRep do
        table.insert(main, nested)
    end
    return main
end

-- V2: Bubble Hub bypass payload (same nesting depth, no repeat cap)
local function buildPayloadBubble()
    local main = {}
    local nested = {{}}
    local current = nested[1]
    for _ = 1, 296 do
        local new = {}
        table.insert(current, new)
        current = new
    end
    for _ = 1, math.floor(State.Power / 298) do
        table.insert(main, nested)
    end
    return main
end

local function startRemoteLoop(buildFn, delay, unlimitedKbps)
    if unlimitedKbps then
        pcall(function()
            game:GetService("NetworkClient"):SetOutgoingKBPSLimit(math.huge)
        end)
    end
    if not remote then
        remote = findRemote()
        if not remote then return end
    end
    payload = buildFn()
    if loopTask then task.cancel(loopTask) loopTask = nil end
    loopTask = task.spawn(function()
        while State.Enabled do
            if not remote then
                remote = findRemote()
                task.wait(1)
            else
                pcall(function() remote:FireServer(payload) end)
                task.wait(delay)
            end
        end
    end)
end

local function stopRemoteLoop()
    if loopTask then task.cancel(loopTask) loopTask = nil end
end

local function startBypass()
    if State.Mode == "V1" then
        startRemoteLoop(buildPayload, 0.125, false)        -- V1 (the previous V2)
    elseif State.Mode == "V2" then
        startRemoteLoop(buildPayloadBubble, 0.12, true)    -- V2 (Bubble Hub bypass)
    end
end

local function stopBypass()
    stopRemoteLoop()
end

local function setBackground(index)
    State.BackgroundIndex = ((index - 1) % #BackgroundIds) + 1
    local imageId = BackgroundIds[State.BackgroundIndex]

    if BGImage.Image ~= imageId then
        if BGTransitionTween then
            BGTransitionTween:Cancel()
        end

        BGTransition.Image = imageId
        BGTransition.ImageTransparency = 1
        BGTransitionTween = TweenService:Create(
            BGTransition,
            TweenInfo.new(0.32, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
            { ImageTransparency = BGImage.ImageTransparency }
        )
        BGTransitionTween.Completed:Connect(function(playbackState)
            if playbackState == Enum.PlaybackState.Completed then
                BGImage.Image = imageId
                BGTransition.ImageTransparency = 1
            end
        end)
        BGTransitionTween:Play()
    end

    BackgroundPreview.Image = imageId

    saveData()
end

BackgroundUp.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    setBackground(State.BackgroundIndex - 1)
end)

BackgroundDown.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    setBackground(State.BackgroundIndex + 1)
end)

BackgroundPreview.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        setBackground(State.BackgroundIndex + 1)
    end
end)

local function powerToAlpha(power)
    return (power - MIN_POWER) / (MAX_POWER - MIN_POWER)
end

local function updateSliderVisual()
    local alpha = powerToAlpha(State.Power)
    SliderFill.Size = UDim2.new(alpha, 0, 1, 0)
    SliderKnob.Position = UDim2.new(alpha, 0, 0.5, 0)
    PowerLabel.Text = formatK(State.Power)
end

local function setPower(value, skipTextbox)
    value = snapPower(value)
    State.Power = value
    updateSliderVisual()
    if not skipTextbox then PowerInput.Text = tostring(value) end
    saveData()
    if State.Enabled and State.Mode == "V1" then
        payload = buildPayload()
    elseif State.Enabled and State.Mode == "V2" then
        payload = buildPayloadBubble()
    end
end

do
    local dragging = false
    local function updateFromInputPosition(inputPos)
        local trackPos = SliderTrack.AbsolutePosition.X
        local trackSize = SliderTrack.AbsoluteSize.X
        local alpha = math.clamp((inputPos - trackPos) / trackSize, 0, 1)
        setPower(MIN_POWER + alpha * (MAX_POWER - MIN_POWER))
    end

    SliderKnob.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragging = true
        end
    end)

    SliderTrack.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragging = true
            updateFromInputPosition(input.Position.X)
        end
    end)

    _conns[#_conns + 1] = UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
            updateFromInputPosition(input.Position.X)
        end
    end)

    _conns[#_conns + 1] = UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragging = false
        end
    end)
end

PowerInput.FocusLost:Connect(function()
    local num = tonumber((PowerInput.Text:gsub(",", "")))
    if num then setPower(num) else PowerInput.Text = tostring(State.Power) end
end)

local function setEnabled(value)
    if State.Enabled == value then return end
    State.Enabled = value
    if State.Enabled then
        startBypass()
    else
        stopBypass()
    end
    applyStartVisual()
end

local function toggleEnabled()
    setEnabled(not State.Enabled)
end

-- drag the compact bar around
do
    local dragging, dragStart, startPos = false, nil, nil
    MiniFrame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragging = true
            dragStart = input.Position
            startPos = MiniFrame.Position
        end
    end)
    _conns[#_conns + 1] = UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
            local d = input.Position - dragStart
            MiniFrame.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + d.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + d.Y)
        end
    end)
    _conns[#_conns + 1] = UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragging = false
        end
    end)
end

local function applyVisibility()
    MainFrame.Visible = panelOpen and not State.Compact
    MiniFrame.Visible = panelOpen and State.Compact
end

setCompact = function(on, skipSave)
    on = on == true
    State.Compact = on
    if on then
        MiniFrame.Position = MainFrame.Position
    else
        MainFrame.Position = MiniFrame.Position
    end
    applyVisibility()
    updateMiniVisual()
    if not skipSave then saveData() end
end

do
    local dragging = false
    local dragStart, startPos

    local function startDrag(input)
        dragging = true
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPos = MainFrame.Position
    end

    local function updateDrag(input)
        if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
            local delta = input.Position - dragStart
            MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(
                startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
                startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
            )
        end
    end

    local function endDrag()
        dragging = false
    end

    TitleBar.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            startDrag(input)
        end
    end)

    _conns[#_conns + 1] = UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(updateDrag)

    _conns[#_conns + 1] = UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            endDrag()
        end
    end)
end

local function checkAutoWalkSpeed()
    if not State.AutoEnable then
        if State.AutoActive then
            State.AutoActive = false
            setEnabled(false)
        end
        return
    end

    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not char then
        if State.AutoActive then
            State.AutoActive = false
            setEnabled(false)
        end
        return
    end

    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hum then
        if State.AutoActive then
            State.AutoActive = false
            setEnabled(false)
        end
        return
    end

    local ws = hum.WalkSpeed
    local inRange = ws >= AUTO_MIN_WS and ws <= AUTO_MAX_WS

    if inRange and not State.Enabled then
        State.AutoActive = true
        setEnabled(true)
    elseif not inRange and State.Enabled and State.AutoActive then
        State.AutoActive = false
        setEnabled(false)
    end
end

local function autoSave()
    saveTimer = saveTimer + 1
    if saveTimer >= saveInterval then
        saveTimer = 0
        saveData()
    end
end

_conns[#_conns + 1] = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    autoSave()
    checkAutoWalkSpeed()
    if not remote then
        remote = findRemote()
    end
end)

_conns[#_conns + 1] = UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
    if State.Listening then
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad1 then
            if input.KeyCode ~= Enum.KeyCode.Unknown then
                State.Keybind = input.KeyCode
                if KeybindButton then KeybindButton.Text = input.KeyCode.Name end
                State.Listening = false
                saveData()
            end
        end
        return
    end
    if gameProcessed then return end
    if State.Keybind and input.KeyCode == State.Keybind then
        toggleEnabled()
    end
end)

updateAccentTheme = function(previousAccent, previousAccentDim)
    for _, object in ipairs(MainFrame:GetDescendants()) do
        if object:IsA("UIStroke") then
            if object.Color == previousAccent then
                object.Color = Theme.Accent
            elseif object.Color == previousAccentDim then
                object.Color = Theme.AccentDim
            end
        elseif object:IsA("TextLabel") or object:IsA("TextButton") or object:IsA("TextBox") then
            if object.TextColor3 == previousAccent then
                object.TextColor3 = Theme.Accent
            end
        elseif object:IsA("GuiObject") then
            if object.BackgroundColor3 == previousAccent then
                object.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Accent
            elseif object.BackgroundColor3 == previousAccentDim then
                object.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.AccentDim
            end
        end
    end

    applyModeVisual()
    applyStartVisual()
    updateToggleVisual()
end

loadData()
setBackground(State.BackgroundIndex)
GuiScale.Scale = State.GuiSize
updateSizeLabel()
applyModeVisual()
applyStartVisual()
updateSliderVisual()
updateToggleVisual()
PowerInput.Text = tostring(State.Power)
if State.Keybind and KeybindButton then
    KeybindButton.Text = State.Keybind.Name
end
setCompact(State.Compact, true)

local function setOpen(on)
    on = on == true
    if panelOpen == on then return end
    panelOpen = on
    applyVisibility()
end

return {
    Toggle = function() setOpen(not panelOpen); return panelOpen end,
    IsOpen = function() return panelOpen end,
    SetOpen = setOpen,
    Destroy = function()
        pcall(function() if State.Enabled then setEnabled(false) end end)
        for _, c in ipairs(_conns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
        _conns = {}
        pcall(function() ScreenGui:Destroy() end)
    end,
}
end)()
_G._GhostccBypassUIRuntime = _G._GhostccBypassUI
end)

    local function addLauncher(order, label, uiGlobal)
        local row = makeRowBase(pSettings, order)
        nameWithUnderline(row, label)

        local chip = Instance.new("Frame", row)

        chipLbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
        chipLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        chipLbl.Text = "OPEN"
        chipLbl.TextColor3 = WHITE
        chipLbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        chipLbl.TextSize = getMobileOptimized(11, 10)
        chipLbl.ZIndex = 7

        local hit = Instance.new("TextButton", row)
        hit.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
        hit.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        hit.Text = ""
        hit.AutoButtonColor = false
        hit.ZIndex = 8

        local function paint(isOpen)
            chipLbl.Text = isOpen and "CLOSE" or "OPEN"
            chipLbl.TextColor3 = isOpen and Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0) or WHITE
            TweenService:Create(chip, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {BackgroundTransparency = isOpen and 0 or 0.65}):Play()
        end
        hit.Activated:Connect(function()
            local ui = _G[uiGlobal]
            if not ui then return end
            paint(ui.Toggle())
        end)
    end

    -- negative orders keep these above every other Settings row, in this order
    addLauncher(-4, "Ping Lagger", "_GhostccPingLaggerUI")
    addLauncher(-3, "Anti Bat", "_GhostccAntiBatUI")
    addLauncher(-1, "Ghost Bypass", "_GhostccBypassUI")

               and true

            if kc == Enum.KeyCode.Escape then kt.Text = (Keybinds.UIToggle ~= Enum.KeyCode.Unknown) and _G._GhostccKeyName(Keybinds.UIToggle) or "None"; _G._GhostccEndKeyCapture(); conn:Disconnect(); return end

        })
        resetGlow.ImageColor3 = R_GREEN
    end

    resetBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

        if confirmTimer then pcall(function() task.cancel(confirmTimer) end); confirmTimer = nil end
        resetTxt.Text = "RESETTING..."

        pcall(function()
            local files = {
                "Velt7Config.json",
                "KrixBtnPosV2.json",
                "AutoPlayConfig.json",
                "KrixDesync_settings.json",
                "HazeHub.json",
                "VynxHub.json",
                "VynxHubConfig.json",
                "VezyUserConfigs.json",
            }
            for _, fname in ipairs(files) do
                pcall(function()
                    if isfile and isfile(fname) and delfile then
                        delfile(fname)
                    end
                end)
            end
        end)

        pcall(function()
            if _G.VezyResetAllToDefaults then _G.VezyResetAllToDefaults() end
        end)

        task.wait(0.4)
        setGreenTheme()
        resetTxt.Text = "DONE"

        confirmState = false
        confirmTimer = task.delay(1.6, function()
            confirmTimer = nil
            if resetBtn.Parent then setRedTheme() end
        end)
    end)

end

_G.VezyBuildConfigSnapshot = function()
    if type(_G._GhostccCollectConfig) == "function" then
        local ok, full = pcall(_G._GhostccCollectConfig)
        if ok and type(full) == "table" then return full end
    end
    local snap = {}
    pcall(function()
        snap.StealRadius = Settings.StealRadius
        snap.StealDuration = Settings.StealDuration
        snap.LAGGER_SPEED = LAGGER_SPEED
        snap.SpeedFamily  = Spd.family
        snap.SpeedCarry   = Spd.carry
        snap.SpeedMethod  = _G._VynxSpeedMethod
        snap.LaggerSpeed_Normal = _G.LaggerSpeed_Normal
        snap.LaggerSpeed_Carry = _G.LaggerSpeed_Carry
        snap.NormalSpeed_Normal = _G.NormalSpeed_Normal
        snap.NormalSpeed_Carry = _G.NormalSpeed_Carry
        snap.SpeedToggleKey = Keybinds.SpeedToggle.Name
        snap.LaggerToggleKey = Keybinds.LaggerToggle.Name
        snap.AutoBatKey = Keybinds.AutoBat.Name
        snap.DropBrainrotKey = Keybinds.DropBrainrot.Name
        snap.TPDownKey = Keybinds.TPDown.Name
        snap.LaggerSpeedKey = Keybinds.LaggerSpeed and Keybinds.LaggerSpeed.Name or "B"
        snap.NormalSpeedKey = Keybinds.NormalSpeed and Keybinds.NormalSpeed.Name or "K"
        snap.InstaResetKey = _G._VynxInstaResetKey
        snap.MedusaCounter = medusaCounterEnabled
        snap.BatCounter = BC and BC.enabled
        snap.AntiRagdoll = Enabled.AntiRagdoll
        snap.InfiniteJump = Enabled.InfiniteJump
        snap.Unwalk = Enabled.Unwalk
    end)
    return snap
end

_G.VezyApplyConfig = function(snap)
    if not snap then return end

    if type(snap.globals) == "table" and type(_G._GhostccApplyConfig) == "function" then
        pcall(_G._GhostccApplyConfig, snap)
        if _G.KRIXSaveNow then pcall(_G.KRIXSaveNow) end
        return
    end

    if _G.VezyResetAllToDefaults then pcall(_G.VezyResetAllToDefaults) end
    task.wait(0.05)
    pcall(function()
        if snap.StealRadius then
            Settings.StealRadius = snap.StealRadius
            Values.STEAL_RADIUS = snap.StealRadius
            if RadiusInput then RadiusInput.Text = tostring(snap.StealRadius) end
        end
        Settings.StealDuration = STEAL_DURATION_FIXED
        Values.STEAL_DURATION  = STEAL_DURATION_FIXED
        if snap.LAGGER_SPEED then
            LAGGER_SPEED = snap.LAGGER_SPEED
            if lsb then lsb.Text = tostring(snap.LAGGER_SPEED) end
        end
        if snap.LaggerSpeed_Normal then _G.LaggerSpeed_Normal = snap.LaggerSpeed_Normal end
        if snap.LaggerSpeed_Carry then _G.LaggerSpeed_Carry = snap.LaggerSpeed_Carry end
        if snap.NormalSpeed_Normal then _G.NormalSpeed_Normal = snap.NormalSpeed_Normal end
        if snap.NormalSpeed_Carry then _G.NormalSpeed_Carry = snap.NormalSpeed_Carry end
        _G._VynxSpeedMethod = "V2"
        if _G._VynxRefreshSpeedMethod then pcall(_G._VynxRefreshSpeedMethod) end
        Spd.SetProfile(snap.SpeedFamily or "normal", snap.SpeedCarry == true)
        local function _f(v) return (v == math.floor(v)) and tostring(math.floor(v)) or string.format("%.1f", v) end
        if lagNormalInput then lagNormalInput.Text = _f(_G.LaggerSpeed_Normal) end
        if lagCarryInput  then lagCarryInput.Text  = _f(_G.LaggerSpeed_Carry)  end
        if normNormalInput then normNormalInput.Text = _f(_G.NormalSpeed_Normal) end
        if normCarryInput  then normCarryInput.Text  = _f(_G.NormalSpeed_Carry)  end
        if snap.SpeedToggleKey and Enum.KeyCode[snap.SpeedToggleKey] then Keybinds.SpeedToggle = Enum.KeyCode[snap.SpeedToggleKey] end
        if snap.LaggerToggleKey and Enum.KeyCode[snap.LaggerToggleKey] then Keybinds.LaggerToggle = Enum.KeyCode[snap.LaggerToggleKey] end
        if snap.AutoBatKey and Enum.KeyCode[snap.AutoBatKey] then Keybinds.AutoBat = Enum.KeyCode[snap.AutoBatKey] end
        if snap.DropBrainrotKey and Enum.KeyCode[snap.DropBrainrotKey] then Keybinds.DropBrainrot = Enum.KeyCode[snap.DropBrainrotKey] end
        if snap.TPDownKey and Enum.KeyCode[snap.TPDownKey] then Keybinds.TPDown = Enum.KeyCode[snap.TPDownKey] end
        if snap.LaggerSpeedKey and Enum.KeyCode[snap.LaggerSpeedKey] then Keybinds.LaggerSpeed = Enum.KeyCode[snap.LaggerSpeedKey] end
        if snap.NormalSpeedKey and Enum.KeyCode[snap.NormalSpeedKey] then Keybinds.NormalSpeed = Enum.KeyCode[snap.NormalSpeedKey] end
        if snap.InstaResetKey then _G._VynxInstaResetKey = snap.InstaResetKey end
        if snap.MedusaCounter ~= nil then
            medusaCounterEnabled = snap.MedusaCounter
            if VisualSetters.MedusaCounter then VisualSetters.MedusaCounter(snap.MedusaCounter) end
        end
        if snap.BatCounter ~= nil and BC then
            BC.enabled = snap.BatCounter
            if VisualSetters.BatCounter then VisualSetters.BatCounter(snap.BatCounter) end
        end

        for kName, lbl in pairs(KB) do
            if Keybinds[kName] and lbl and lbl.Parent then lbl.Text = _G._GhostccKeyName(Keybinds[kName]) end
        end
    end)
    if _G.KRIXSaveNow then _G.KRIXSaveNow() end
end

_G.VezyResetAllToDefaults = function()
    _G._GhostccSettingsReset = true
    pcall(function()

        for k in pairs(Keybinds) do
            Keybinds[k] = Enum.KeyCode.Unknown
        end
        if type(_G._AdaptAPKeybinds) == "table" then
            for k in pairs(_G._AdaptAPKeybinds) do
                _G._AdaptAPKeybinds[k] = Enum.KeyCode.Unknown
            end
        end
        _G._VynxInstaResetKey = nil
        for _, lbl in pairs(KB) do
            if typeof(lbl) == "Instance" and lbl:IsA("TextLabel") then lbl.Text = "..." end
        end

        NORMAL_SPEED = 60
        CARRY_SPEED  = 29
        LAGGER_SPEED = 50
        _G._BASE_NORMAL = 60
        _G._BASE_CARRY  = 29
        _G.NormalSpeed_Normal = 60
        _G.NormalSpeed_Carry  = 29
        _G.LaggerSpeed_Normal = 50
        _G.LaggerSpeed_Carry  = 25
        _G._VynxSpeedMethod = "V2"
        if _G._VynxRefreshSpeedMethod then pcall(_G._VynxRefreshSpeedMethod) end
        Spd.SetProfile("normal", false)

        Settings.StealRadius   = 62
        Settings.StealDuration = STEAL_DURATION_FIXED
        Values.STEAL_RADIUS    = 62
        Values.STEAL_DURATION  = STEAL_DURATION_FIXED

        if RadiusInput then RadiusInput.Text = "62" end
        if nsb then nsb.Text = tostring(NORMAL_SPEED) end
        if csb then csb.Text = tostring(CARRY_SPEED) end
        if lsb then lsb.Text = tostring(LAGGER_SPEED) end
        local function _f(v) return (v == math.floor(v)) and tostring(math.floor(v)) or string.format("%.1f", v) end
        if lagNormalInput then lagNormalInput.Text = _f(_G.LaggerSpeed_Normal) end
        if lagCarryInput  then lagCarryInput.Text  = _f(_G.LaggerSpeed_Carry)  end
        if normNormalInput then normNormalInput.Text = _f(_G.NormalSpeed_Normal) end
        if normCarryInput  then normCarryInput.Text  = _f(_G.NormalSpeed_Carry)  end

        Enabled.AutoSteal = false
        if VisualSetters.AutoSteal then pcall(VisualSetters.AutoSteal, false) end

        Enabled.AutoBat = false
        autoBatToggled = false
        if VisualSetters.AutoBat then pcall(VisualSetters.AutoBat, false) end

        if VisualSetters.AutoSwing then pcall(VisualSetters.AutoSwing, false) end
        if VisualSetters.HarderHitAnim then pcall(VisualSetters.HarderHitAnim, false) end
        medusaCounterEnabled = false
        if VisualSetters.MedusaCounter then pcall(VisualSetters.MedusaCounter, false) end
        if BC then BC.enabled = false end
        if VisualSetters.BatCounter then pcall(VisualSetters.BatCounter, false) end
        if VisualSetters.BatCounterChase then pcall(VisualSetters.BatCounterChase, false) end
        if VisualSetters.FastestSteal then pcall(VisualSetters.FastestSteal, false) end
        if VisualSetters.Desync then pcall(VisualSetters.Desync, false) end
        if VisualSetters.BrainrotReturnL then pcall(VisualSetters.BrainrotReturnL, false) end
        if VisualSetters.BrainrotReturnR then pcall(VisualSetters.BrainrotReturnR, false) end

        Enabled.InfiniteJump = false
        if VisualSetters.InfiniteJump then pcall(VisualSetters.InfiniteJump, false) end
        Enabled.AntiRagdoll = false
        if VisualSetters.AntiRagdoll then pcall(VisualSetters.AntiRagdoll, false) end
        Enabled.Unwalk = false
        if VisualSetters.Unwalk then pcall(VisualSetters.Unwalk, false) end

        if VisualSetters.StretchRez then pcall(VisualSetters.StretchRez, false) end
        if VisualSetters.NoCamCollision then pcall(VisualSetters.NoCamCollision, false) end
        if VisualSetters.AntiLag then pcall(VisualSetters.AntiLag, false) end
        if VisualSetters.UltraMode then pcall(VisualSetters.UltraMode, false) end
        Enabled.RemoveAccessories = false
        if VisualSetters.RemoveAccessories then pcall(VisualSetters.RemoveAccessories, false) end
        Enabled.Optimizer = false

        _G._VezyJumpMode = "Manual"
        if _G._VezyCustomFontOn then
            _G._VezyCustomFontOn = false
            if _G.VezyDisableCustomFont then pcall(_G.VezyDisableCustomFont) end
        end

        _G._VezyStretchFOV = 120

        _G._VezyBatAimbotSpeed = 58
        _G._VezyBatAimbotSpeedLagger = 40
        _G._VezyBatAimbotOn = false
        if _G.VezyStopBatAimbot then pcall(_G.VezyStopBatAimbot) end
        _G._VezyBatCounterOn = false
        if _G.VezyStopBatCounter then pcall(_G.VezyStopBatCounter) end

        for _, setter in pairs(VisualSetters) do pcall(setter, false) end
        for eName in pairs(Enabled) do Enabled[eName] = false end

        for kName, lbl in pairs(KB) do
            if lbl and lbl.Parent then
                local kc = Keybinds[kName]
                lbl.Text = _G._GhostccKeyName(kc)
            end
        end
        if _G._VynxRefreshDuelLaggerKey then pcall(_G._VynxRefreshDuelLaggerKey) end
        if _G._VynxRefreshInstaResetKey then pcall(_G._VynxRefreshInstaResetKey) end

        pcall(function()
            _G._VezyMobileBtnPos = {}
            _G._VynxMobileBtnScale = 1.20
            if _G._VynxResetMobileBtnPos then _G._VynxResetMobileBtnPos() end
            if _G._VynxApplyMobileBtnScale then _G._VynxApplyMobileBtnScale(1.20) end
            if _G._VynxRefreshMobileBtnSizeButtons then _G._VynxRefreshMobileBtnSizeButtons() end
        end)
        pcall(function()
            _G._AdaptStealBarScale = 1.0
            if _G._VynxResetStealBarPos then _G._VynxResetStealBarPos() end
            if _G._RaVeSetStealBarScale then _G._RaVeSetStealBarScale(100 * (_G._GhostccDeviceScale or 1)) end
            if _G._VynxRefreshStealBarScale then pcall(_G._VynxRefreshStealBarScale) end
        end)
        pcall(function()
            if _G._GhostccResetPanels then _G._GhostccResetPanels() end
            for _, st in ipairs({ _G._GhostccDuelLagger, _G._GhostccPingLagger, _G._GhostccSpeedBypass }) do
                if type(st) == "table" then st.key = nil end
            end
            if _G._GhostccRefreshAllPanelKeys then pcall(_G._GhostccRefreshAllPanelKeys) end
        end)
        pcall(function()
            local outer = _G.VynxOuterRef
            if outer and outer.Parent then
                outer.Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, 110)
                outer.Size = UDim2.new(0, 330, 0, 470)
            end
            UI_SCALE = 1.0
            if _G._VynxApplyUIScale then _G._VynxApplyUIScale(1.0) end
            if _G._VynxRefreshUISizeButtons then pcall(_G._VynxRefreshUISizeButtons) end
        end)
    end)
    _G._GhostccSettingsReset = false
    if _G.KRIXSaveNowInstant then pcall(_G.KRIXSaveNowInstant) end
end

_G.VezySaveUserConfigs = function()
    if not writefile then return end
    pcall(function()
        local json = HttpService:JSONEncode(_G._VezyUserConfigs)
        writefile("VezyUserConfigs.json", json)
    end)
end

_G.VezyLoadUserConfigs = function()
    if not readfile then return end
    pcall(function()
        if isfile and isfile("VezyUserConfigs.json") then
            local data = readfile("VezyUserConfigs.json")
            local ok, decoded = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(data) end)
            if ok and type(decoded) == "table" then
                _G._VezyUserConfigs = decoded
            end
        end
    end)
end

local function makeUserConfigRow(name)
    local row = Instance.new("Frame", pSettings)
    row.Name = "UserConfig_" .. name
    row.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, getMobileOptimized(38, 34))
    row.BackgroundColor3 = CARD
    row.BorderSizePixel = 0
    _G._VezyUserConfigOrder = _G._VezyUserConfigOrder + 1
    row.LayoutOrder = _G._VezyUserConfigOrder
    row.ZIndex = 4
    Instance.new("UICorner", row).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)
    local rSt = Instance.new("UIStroke", row)
    rSt.Color = ACC; rSt.Thickness = 1; rSt.Transparency = 0.5

    local loadBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", row)
    loadBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, -42, 1, 0)
    loadBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
    loadBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    loadBtn.Text = string.upper(name)
    loadBtn.TextColor3 = WHITE
    loadBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    loadBtn.TextSize = getMobileOptimized(11, 10)
    loadBtn.AutoButtonColor = false
    loadBtn.ZIndex = 5

    local delBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", row)
    delBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 30, 0, 22)
    delBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -36, 0.5, -11)
    delBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 22, 22)
    delBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
    delBtn.Text = "x"
    delBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(230, 110, 110)
    delBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    delBtn.TextSize = 12
    delBtn.AutoButtonColor = false
    delBtn.ZIndex = 6
    Instance.new("UICorner", delBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)

    row.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
        TweenService:Create(row, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {BackgroundColor3 = CARD2}):Play()
        TweenService:Create(rSt, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {Transparency = 0.1}):Play()
    end)
    row.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
        TweenService:Create(row, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {BackgroundColor3 = CARD}):Play()
        TweenService:Create(rSt, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {Transparency = 0.5}):Play()
    end)

    loadBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        if _G._VezyUserConfigs[name] then
            _G.VezyApplyConfig(_G._VezyUserConfigs[name])
            TweenService:Create(row, TweenInfo.new(0.1), {BackgroundColor3 = ACC}):Play()
            loadBtn.Text = "LOADED!"
            loadBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
            task.delay(1.2, function()
                if row and row.Parent then
                    TweenService:Create(row, TweenInfo.new(0.3), {BackgroundColor3 = CARD}):Play()
                    loadBtn.Text = string.upper(name)
                    loadBtn.TextColor3 = WHITE
                end
            end)
        end
    end)

    delBtn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
        TweenService:Create(delBtn, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(70, 30, 30)}):Play()
    end)
    delBtn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
        TweenService:Create(delBtn, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 22, 22)}):Play()
    end)
    delBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        _G._VezyUserConfigs[name] = nil
        _G._VezyUserConfigButtons[name] = nil
        if _G.VezySaveUserConfigs then _G.VezySaveUserConfigs() end

        TweenService:Create(row, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)}):Play()
        task.delay(0.25, function() if row and row.Parent then row:Destroy() end end)
    end)

    _G._VezyUserConfigButtons[name] = row
    return row
end

do
    local saveRow = Instance.new("Frame", pSettings)
    saveRow.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, getMobileOptimized(38, 34))
    saveRow.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    saveRow.BorderSizePixel = 0
    saveRow.LayoutOrder = 31
    saveRow.ZIndex = 4

    local inputBg = Instance.new("Frame", saveRow)
    inputBg.Size = UDim2.new(0.65, -4, 1, 0)
    inputBg.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
    inputBg.BackgroundColor3 = CARD
    inputBg.BorderSizePixel = 0
    Instance.new("UICorner", inputBg).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)
    local inSt = Instance.new("UIStroke", inputBg)
    inSt.Color = ACC; inSt.Thickness = 1; inSt.Transparency = 0.5

    local nameBox = Instance.new("TextBox", inputBg)
    nameBox.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 1, 0)
    nameBox.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 0)
    nameBox.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    nameBox.Text = ""
    nameBox.PlaceholderText = "Config name..."
    nameBox.PlaceholderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 120, 130)
    nameBox.TextColor3 = WHITE
    nameBox.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    nameBox.TextSize = getMobileOptimized(11, 10)
    nameBox.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    nameBox.ClearTextOnFocus = false
    nameBox.ZIndex = 5

    nameBox.Focused:Connect(function()
        TweenService:Create(inSt, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {Color = ACC, Transparency = 0}):Play()
    end)
    nameBox.FocusLost:Connect(function()
        TweenService:Create(inSt, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {Color = ACC, Transparency = 0.5}):Play()
    end)

    local saveBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", saveRow)
    saveBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0.35, -4, 1, 0)
    saveBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.65, 4, 0, 0)
    saveBtn.BackgroundColor3 = ACC
    saveBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
    saveBtn.Text = "SAVE"
    saveBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
    saveBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
    saveBtn.TextSize = getMobileOptimized(11, 10)
    saveBtn.AutoButtonColor = false
    saveBtn.ZIndex = 5
    Instance.new("UICorner", saveBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)

    saveBtn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
        TweenService:Create(saveBtn, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(225, 225, 225)}):Play()
    end)
    saveBtn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
        TweenService:Create(saveBtn, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {BackgroundColor3 = ACC}):Play()
    end)

    saveBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        local name = (nameBox.Text or ""):gsub("^%s*(.-)%s*$", "%1")
        if name == "" then

            local origPos = inputBg.Position
            for i = 1, 3 do
                TweenService:Create(inputBg, TweenInfo.new(0.04), {Position = UDim2.new(origPos.X.Scale, origPos.X.Offset + 6, origPos.Y.Scale, origPos.Y.Offset)}):Play()
                task.wait(0.05)
                TweenService:Create(inputBg, TweenInfo.new(0.04), {Position = UDim2.new(origPos.X.Scale, origPos.X.Offset - 6, origPos.Y.Scale, origPos.Y.Offset)}):Play()
                task.wait(0.05)
            end
            TweenService:Create(inputBg, TweenInfo.new(0.05), {Position = origPos}):Play()
            return
        end

        if #name > 20 then name = name:sub(1, 20) end

        _G._VezyUserConfigs[name] = _G.VezyBuildConfigSnapshot()
        if _G.VezySaveUserConfigs then _G.VezySaveUserConfigs() end

        if not _G._VezyUserConfigButtons[name] then
            makeUserConfigRow(name)
        end
        nameBox.Text = ""

        TweenService:Create(saveBtn, TweenInfo.new(0.1), {BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(235, 235, 235)}):Play()
        saveBtn.Text = "SAVED!"
        task.delay(1.0, function()
            if saveBtn and saveBtn.Parent then
                TweenService:Create(saveBtn, TweenInfo.new(0.3), {BackgroundColor3 = ACC}):Play()
                saveBtn.Text = "SAVE"
            end
        end)
    end)
end

task.spawn(function()
    task.wait(0.5)
    pcall(function() _G.VezyLoadUserConfigs() end)
    if _G._VezyUserConfigs then
        for name, _ in pairs(_G._VezyUserConfigs) do
            if not _G._VezyUserConfigButtons[name] then
                pcall(function() makeUserConfigRow(name) end)
            end
        end
    end
end)
end -- removed saved/shared configuration controls
