reopenWord.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(12, 12, 16)
reopenWord.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
reopenWord.ZIndex = 42
-- Solid black bubble lettering; retain the animated outline below.
local reopenOutline = Instance.new("UIStroke")
reopenOutline.Name = "GhostDuelMovingOutline"
reopenOutline.Thickness = 1.8
reopenOutline.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 190, 80)
reopenOutline.Parent = reopenWord
applyGhostDuelShimmer(reopenWord)
-- Every menu button briefly receives a red border while pressed/clicked.
local function bindRedButtonEdge(button)
    if not button or (not button:IsA("TextButton") and not button:IsA("ImageButton")) then return end
    if button:GetAttribute("GhostRedEdgeBound") then return end
    button:SetAttribute("GhostRedEdgeBound", true)
    local edge = button:FindFirstChild("GhostRedClickEdge")
    if not edge then
        edge = Instance.new("UIStroke")
        edge.Name = "GhostRedClickEdge"
        edge.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
        edge.Thickness = 1.8
        edge.Color = Color3.fromRGB(225, 20, 35)
        edge.Transparency = 1
        edge.Parent = button
    end
    local function flashRed()
        if not edge or not edge.Parent then return end
        edge.Color = Color3.fromRGB(225, 20, 35)
        TweenService:Create(edge, TweenInfo.new(0.08), {Transparency = 0}):Play()
        task.delay(0.42, function()
            if edge and edge.Parent then
                TweenService:Create(edge, TweenInfo.new(0.28), {Transparency = 1}):Play()
            end
        end)
    end
    button.Activated:Connect(flashRed)
end
for _, descendant in ipairs(gui:GetDescendants()) do bindRedButtonEdge(descendant) end
gui.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(descendant)
    task.defer(function() bindRedButtonEdge(descendant) end)
end)

local reopenOutlineGradient = Instance.new("UIGradient")
reopenOutlineGradient.Color = ColorSequence.new({
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, Color3.fromRGB(220, 20, 35)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(12, 12, 16))
})
reopenOutlineGradient.Rotation = 45
reopenOutlineGradient.Parent = reopenOutline
task.spawn(function()
    while reopenWord.Parent and reopenOutlineGradient.Parent do
        local forward = TweenService:Create(reopenOutlineGradient, TweenInfo.new(1.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut), {Offset = Vector2.new(1, 0)})
        forward:Play(); forward.Completed:Wait()
        if not reopenWord.Parent then break end
        local backward = TweenService:Create(reopenOutlineGradient, TweenInfo.new(1.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut), {Offset = Vector2.new(-1, 0)})
        backward:Play(); backward.Completed:Wait()
    end
end)

do
    local dragging, dragStart, startPos, moved, activeInput
    reopenBtn.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if _G._VynxUILocked then return end
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
           or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragging, dragStart, startPos = true, input.Position, reopenBtn.Position
            moved, activeInput = false, input
            reopenBtn:SetAttribute("_Moved", false)
        end
    end)
    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if not dragging then return end
        if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
           and input ~= activeInput then return end
        local delta = input.Position - dragStart
        if math.abs(delta.X) > 5 or math.abs(delta.Y) > 5 then
            moved = true
            reopenBtn:SetAttribute("_Moved", true)
        end
        reopenBtn.Position = UDim2.new(
            startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
            startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
        )
    end)
    UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if not dragging then return end
        if input == activeInput or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
            dragging, activeInput = false, nil
            if moved then
                task.delay(0.15, function() reopenBtn:SetAttribute("_Moved", false) end)
            end
        end
    end)
end

do

    _G._VynxMobileBtnScale = _G._VynxMobileBtnScale or 1.20
    local function _bsize() return math.clamp(_G._VynxMobileBtnScale or 1.0, 0.7, 2.0) * DEVICE_UI_SCALE end
    -- Ghost Better Steal-style tiles: tall rounded cards with a violet gradient.
    local MB_BASE_W, MB_BASE_H = 54, 46
    local MB_BASE_GX, MB_BASE_GY = 60, 52
    local MB_W = math.floor(MB_BASE_W * _bsize() + 0.5)
    local MB_H = math.floor(MB_BASE_H * _bsize() + 0.5)
    local MB_GX = math.floor(MB_BASE_GX * _bsize() + 0.5)
    local MB_GY = math.floor(MB_BASE_GY * _bsize() + 0.5)
    local MB_BG        = Color3.fromRGB(245, 245, 245)
    local MB_BG_LIGHT  = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    local MB_BG_HOV    = Color3.fromRGB(225, 225, 225)
    local MB_ACTIVE    = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 25)
    local MB_ACTIVE_L  = Color3.fromRGB(65, 65, 65)
    local MB_TXT       = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 25)
    local MB_TXT_ON    = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    -- Keep this mobile-button palette monochrome, independent of menu themes.
    local function MBc(c)
        return c
    end

    local MB_FULL_W = MB_GX * 2 + MB_W
    local MB_FULL_H = MB_GY * 3 + MB_H

    local mobileFrame = Instance.new("Frame", gui)
    mobileFrame.Name = "VezyMobileButtons"
    mobileFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, MB_FULL_W, 0, MB_FULL_H)
    mobileFrame.Position = UDim2.new(1, -(MB_FULL_W + 18), 0.5, -MB_FULL_H / 2)
    mobileFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    -- This transparent layout helper must never capture touch input.
    mobileFrame.Active = false
    mobileFrame.Selectable = false
    mobileFrame.ZIndex = 100
    _G._VezyMobileButtonsFrame = mobileFrame

    -- Staggered three/two/three/two layout, matching the reference control pad.
    local MOBILE_LAYOUT_VERSION = 10
    if _G._VynxMobileAppliedLayoutVersion ~= MOBILE_LAYOUT_VERSION then
        _G._VezyMobileBtnPos = nil
        _G._VynxMobileAppliedLayoutVersion = MOBILE_LAYOUT_VERSION
    end
    _G._VynxMobileLayoutVersion = MOBILE_LAYOUT_VERSION

    local mobileBtnDefs = {
        -- Top row: 3 tiles.
        {name = "TP DOWN",        key = "tpDown",      col = 0, row = 0},
        {name = "LAGGER\nCARRY",  key = "laggerCarry", col = 1, row = 0},
        {name = "AUTO\nLEFT",     key = "autoLeft",    col = 2, row = 0},
        -- Second row: the two right-hand tiles.
        {name = "AUTO\nRIGHT",    key = "autoRight",   col = 0, row = 1},
        {name = "DROP\nBRAINROT", key = "drop",        col = 1, row = 1},
        -- Third row: 3 tiles.
        {name = "BAT\nAIMBOT",    key = "batLock",     col = 0, row = 2},
        {name = "CARRY\nSPEED",   key = "carry",       col = 1, row = 2},
        -- Bottom row: the two right-hand tiles.
        {name = "INSTA\nRESET",   key = "reset",       col = 0, row = 3},
        {name = "LAGGER\nMODE",   key = "laggerSpeed", col = 1, row = 3},
    }

    -- Tight tile geometry: 5px between cells, 12px in from the screen edge,
    -- rows centred on the vertical midpoint. col counts outward from the right
    -- screen edge, so col 0 sits flush right.
    local MB_CELL_GAP = 5
    local MB_EDGE_PAD = 12
    local MB_ROWS = 1
    for _, def in ipairs(mobileBtnDefs) do
        if def.row + 1 > MB_ROWS then MB_ROWS = def.row + 1 end
    end

    local mobileButtonRefs = {}
    for _, def in ipairs(mobileBtnDefs) do
        local btn = Instance.new("TextButton", gui)
        btn.Name = "MB_" .. def.key
        btn.Size = UDim2.new(0, MB_W, 0, MB_H)

        local baseX = -((def.col + 1) * MB_W + def.col * MB_CELL_GAP + MB_EDGE_PAD)
        local baseY = (def.row - (MB_ROWS - 1) / 2) * (MB_H + MB_CELL_GAP) - MB_H / 2

        local savedPos = _G._VezyMobileBtnPos and _G._VezyMobileBtnPos[def.key]
        if savedPos then
            btn.Position = UDim2.new(savedPos.xs, savedPos.xo, savedPos.ys, savedPos.yo)
        else
            btn.Position = UDim2.new(1, baseX, 0.5, baseY)
        end
        btn.BackgroundColor3 = MBc(MB_BG)
        btn.BorderSizePixel = 0
        btn.Text = def.name
        btn.TextColor3 = MB_TXT
        btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
        btn.TextSize = math.floor(11 * _bsize() + 0.5)
        btn.TextWrapped = true
        btn.AutoButtonColor = false
        btn.ZIndex = 101
        local btnCorner = Instance.new("UICorner", btn)
        btnCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
        btn.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 18, 86)
        btn.TextStrokeTransparency = 1
        local bGrad = Instance.new("UIGradient", btn)
        bGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new(MBc(MB_BG), MBc(MB_BG_LIGHT))
        bGrad.Rotation = 135
        local bSt = Instance.new("UIStroke", btn)
        bSt.Color = Color3.fromRGB(65, 65, 65)
        bSt.Thickness = 1.5
        bSt.Transparency = 1
        bSt.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
        mobileButtonRefs[def.key] = {btn = btn, stroke = bSt, gradient = bGrad, corner = btnCorner, active = false, dragGuard = false}

        btn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
            if mobileButtonRefs[def.key].active then return end
            TweenService:Create(btn, TweenInfo.new(0.12), {BackgroundColor3 = MBc(MB_BG_HOV)}):Play()
        end)
        btn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
            if mobileButtonRefs[def.key].active then return end
            TweenService:Create(btn, TweenInfo.new(0.12), {BackgroundColor3 = MBc(MB_BG)}):Play()
        end)

        do
            local ref = mobileButtonRefs[def.key]
            local pressing, dragging = false, false
            local pressPos, btnStart = nil, nil
            local DRAG_THRESHOLD = 6

            btn.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
                if _G._VynxUILocked then return end
                if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
                   or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                    pressing = true
                    dragging = false
                    pressPos = input.Position
                    btnStart = btn.Position
                end
            end)

            UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
                if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
                   and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
                if not pressing then return end
                pressing = false
                if dragging then
                    dragging = false
                    _G._VezyMobileBtnPos = _G._VezyMobileBtnPos or {}
                    _G._VezyMobileBtnPos[def.key] = {
                        xs = btn.Position.X.Scale, xo = btn.Position.X.Offset,
                        ys = btn.Position.Y.Scale, yo = btn.Position.Y.Offset,
                    }
                    if _G.KRIXSaveNow then _G.KRIXSaveNow() end
                    task.delay(0.15, function() ref.dragGuard = false end)
                end
            end)

            UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
                if not pressing then return end
                if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
                   and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
                local delta = input.Position - pressPos
                if not dragging then
                    if math.abs(delta.X) > DRAG_THRESHOLD or math.abs(delta.Y) > DRAG_THRESHOLD then
                        dragging = true
                        ref.dragGuard = true
                    end
                end
                if dragging then
                    btn.Position = UDim2.new(
                        btnStart.X.Scale, btnStart.X.Offset + delta.X,
                        btnStart.Y.Scale, btnStart.Y.Offset + delta.Y
                    )
                end
            end)
        end
    end

    local function setMobileBtnState(key, on)
        local ref = mobileButtonRefs[key]
        if not ref then return end
        ref.active = on
        if ref.gradient then
            ref.gradient.Color = ColorSequence.new(
                MBc(on and MB_ACTIVE or MB_BG),
                MBc(on and MB_ACTIVE_L or MB_BG_LIGHT)
            )
        end
        TweenService:Create(ref.btn, TweenInfo.new(0.12), {
            BackgroundColor3 = MBc(on and MB_ACTIVE or MB_BG),
            TextColor3 = on and MB_TXT_ON or MB_TXT,
            TextStrokeTransparency = 1,
        }):Play()
        TweenService:Create(ref.stroke, TweenInfo.new(0.12), {
            Color = on and Color3.fromRGB(255, 35, 45) or Color3.fromRGB(65, 65, 65),
            Transparency = on and 0 or 1,
            Thickness = on and 2.5 or 1,
        }):Play()
    end
    _G._VynxSetMobileBtnState = setMobileBtnState
    -- Re-applies each button's colors after a theme change
    _G._VynxRefreshMobileBtnColors = function()
        for key, ref in pairs(mobileButtonRefs) do
            pcall(setMobileBtnState, key, ref.active == true)
            if ref.stroke and ref.stroke.Parent and ref.active ~= true then
                ref.stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(65, 65, 65)
            end
        end
    end

    _G._VynxMobileDropBR = function()
        if runDropBrainrot then task.spawn(runDropBrainrot) end
        setMobileBtnState("drop", true)
        task.delay(0.15, function() setMobileBtnState("drop", false) end)
    end

    local function apState()
        local ap = _G._AutoPath
        return (ap and ap.L) == true, (ap and ap.R) == true
    end

    _G._VynxMobileAutoLeft = function()
        local l = apState()
        if _G._VynxToggleAutoLeft then pcall(_G._VynxToggleAutoLeft) end
        local nl, nr = apState()
        setMobileBtnState("autoLeft", nl)
        setMobileBtnState("autoRight", nr)
    end

    _G._VynxMobileAutoRight = function()
        local _, r = apState()
        if _G._VynxToggleAutoRight then pcall(_G._VynxToggleAutoRight) end
        local nl, nr = apState()
        setMobileBtnState("autoLeft", nl)
        setMobileBtnState("autoRight", nr)
    end

    _G._VynxMobileTPDown = function()
        -- Use the active TP Down handler, with the compatibility alias as fallback.
        local action = _G._VynxRunTPDown
        if type(action) ~= "function" or action == _noop then
            action = _G._AdaptRunTPDown
        end

        if type(action) ~= "function" or action == _noop then
            warn("[GHOST DUEL] TP DOWN handler is not ready.")
            return
        end

        local ok, err = pcall(action)
        if not ok then
            warn("[GHOST DUEL] TP DOWN failed: " .. tostring(err))
            return
        end

        setMobileBtnState("tpDown", true)
        task.delay(0.15, function()
            if setMobileBtnState then setMobileBtnState("tpDown", false) end
        end)
    end

    _G._VynxMobileCarry = function()
        Spd.Button("normal", true)
    end

    _G._VynxMobileBatBot = function()
        local newOn = not (_G._VezyBatAimbotOn or false)
        local setter = VisualSetters.AutoBat
        if setter then pcall(setter, newOn) end
        setMobileBtnState("batLock", _G._VezyBatAimbotOn == true)
        if _G.KRIXSaveNow then pcall(_G.KRIXSaveNow) end
    end

    _G._VynxMobileBatCtr = function()
        _G._VynxBatCounterActive = not (_G._VynxBatCounterActive or false)
        setMobileBtnState("batCounter", _G._VynxBatCounterActive)
        _G._VezyBatCounterOn = _G._VynxBatCounterActive
        if _G._VynxBatCounterActive then
            if _G.VezyStartBatCounter then _G.VezyStartBatCounter() end
        else
            if _G.VezyStopBatCounter then _G.VezyStopBatCounter() end
        end
        if VisualSetters.BatCounter then pcall(VisualSetters.BatCounter, _G._VynxBatCounterActive) end
    end

    _G._VynxMobileLagger = function()
        Spd.Button("lagger", true)
    end

    _G._VynxMobileReset = function()
        if _G.VynxDoInstaReset then pcall(_G.VynxDoInstaReset) end
        setMobileBtnState("reset", true)
        task.delay(0.15, function() setMobileBtnState("reset", false) end)
    end

    _G._VynxMobileLaggerSpeed = function()
        Spd.Button("lagger", false)
    end

    _G._GhostccSyncMobileSpeedBtns = function()
        local want = {
            carry       = (Spd.family == "normal") and Spd.carry,
            laggerCarry = (Spd.family == "lagger") and Spd.carry,
            laggerSpeed = (Spd.family == "lagger") and not Spd.carry,
        }
        for key, on in pairs(want) do
            local ref = mobileButtonRefs[key]
            if ref and ref.active ~= (on and true or false) then
                setMobileBtnState(key, on and true or false)
            end
        end
    end

    local mobileActions = {
        drop        = function() _G._VynxMobileDropBR() end,
        autoLeft    = function() _G._VynxMobileAutoLeft() end,
        reset       = function() _G._VynxMobileReset() end,
        batLock     = function() _G._VynxMobileBatBot() end,
        autoRight   = function() _G._VynxMobileAutoRight() end,
        tpDown      = function() _G._VynxMobileTPDown() end,
        carry       = function() _G._VynxMobileCarry() end,
        laggerCarry = function() _G._VynxMobileLagger() end,
        laggerSpeed = function() _G._VynxMobileLaggerSpeed() end,
    }
    for key, fn in pairs(mobileActions) do
        local ref = mobileButtonRefs[key]
        if ref then
            -- Activated handles both mouse clicks and mobile touch consistently.
            ref.btn.Activated:Connect(function()
                if ref.dragGuard then return end
                local ok, err = pcall(fn)
                if not ok then
                    warn("[GHOST DUEL] Button action failed (" .. tostring(key) .. "): " .. tostring(err))
                end
            end)
        end
    end

    task.spawn(function()
        while task.wait(0.15) do
            if hubStale() then break end
            local ap = _G._AutoPath
            local apL, apR = (ap and ap.L) == true, (ap and ap.R) == true
            if mobileButtonRefs["autoLeft"] and mobileButtonRefs["autoLeft"].active ~= apL then
                setMobileBtnState("autoLeft", apL)
            end
            if mobileButtonRefs["autoRight"] and mobileButtonRefs["autoRight"].active ~= apR then
                setMobileBtnState("autoRight", apR)
            end
            _G._GhostccSyncMobileSpeedBtns()
            if mobileButtonRefs["batLock"] and mobileButtonRefs["batLock"].active ~= (_G._VezyBatAimbotOn or false) then
                setMobileBtnState("batLock", _G._VezyBatAimbotOn or false)
            end
        end
    end)

    local MB_GAP = MB_BASE_GX - MB_BASE_W
    local function mbMetrics(s)
        local circle = _G._VynxMobileCircle == true
        local w   = math.floor(MB_BASE_W * s + 0.5)
        local h   = circle and w or math.floor(MB_BASE_H * s + 0.5)
        local gap = math.floor(MB_GAP * s + 0.5)
        local gx  = circle and (w + gap) or math.floor(MB_BASE_GX * s + 0.5)
        local gy  = circle and (h + gap) or math.floor(MB_BASE_GY * s + 0.5)
        return w, h, gx, gy
    end

    local function mbDefaultPos(def, s)
        local w, h = mbMetrics(s)
        local xOffset = -((def.col + 1) * w + def.col * MB_CELL_GAP + MB_EDGE_PAD)
        local yOffset = (def.row - (MB_ROWS - 1) / 2) * (h + MB_CELL_GAP) - h / 2
        return UDim2.new(1, xOffset, 0.5, yOffset)
    end

    _G._VynxResetMobileBtnPos = function()
        _G._VezyMobileBtnPos = {}
        local s = math.clamp(_G._VynxMobileBtnScale or 1.0, 0.7, 2.0)
        for _, def in ipairs(mobileBtnDefs) do
            local ref = mobileButtonRefs[def.key]
            if ref and ref.btn then
                TweenService:Create(ref.btn, TweenInfo.new(0.18), {Position = mbDefaultPos(def, s)}):Play()
            end
        end
        if _G.KRIXSaveNowInstant then pcall(_G.KRIXSaveNowInstant) end
        if _G.KRIXSaveNow then pcall(_G.KRIXSaveNow) end
    end

    _G._VynxMobileCircle = _G._VynxMobileCircle or false
    _G._VynxMobileShown  = _G._VynxMobileShown or {}

    _G._VynxMobileButtonList = {}
    for _, def in ipairs(mobileBtnDefs) do
        table.insert(_G._VynxMobileButtonList, {
            key = def.key,
            label = (def.name:gsub("\n", " ")),
        })
    end

    local function mbShown(key)
        if _G._VezyHideSideBtns == true then return false end
        return _G._VynxMobileShown[key] ~= false
    end

    _G._VynxApplyMobileBtnScale = function(newScale)
        _G._VynxMobileBtnScale = math.clamp(newScale or 1.0, 0.7, 2.0)
        local s = _G._VynxMobileBtnScale * DEVICE_UI_SCALE
        local circle = _G._VynxMobileCircle == true
        local nw, nh = mbMetrics(s)
        local newTextSize = math.floor((circle and 11 or 11) * s + 0.5)
        for _, def in ipairs(mobileBtnDefs) do
            local ref = mobileButtonRefs[def.key]
            if ref and ref.btn then
                ref.btn.Size = UDim2.new(0, nw, 0, nh)
                ref.btn.TextSize = newTextSize
                ref.btn.Visible = mbShown(def.key)
                if ref.corner then
                    ref.corner.CornerRadius = circle and UDim.new(1, 0) or UDim.new(0, 14)
                end
                if not (_G._VezyMobileBtnPos and _G._VezyMobileBtnPos[def.key]) then
                    ref.btn.Position = mbDefaultPos(def, s)
                end
            end
        end
    end

    _G._VynxSetMobileCircle = function(on)
        _G._VynxMobileCircle = on and true or false
        _G._VynxApplyMobileBtnScale(_G._VynxMobileBtnScale)
    end

    _G._VynxSetMobileButtonShown = function(key, on)
        _G._VynxMobileShown[key] = (on ~= false) and true or false
        local ref = mobileButtonRefs[key]
        if ref and ref.btn then ref.btn.Visible = mbShown(key) end
    end

    _G._VynxRefreshMobileButtons = function()
        _G._VynxApplyMobileBtnScale(_G._VynxMobileBtnScale)
    end

    _G._VynxApplyMobileBtnScale(_G._VynxMobileBtnScale)
end

reopenBtn.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
    reopenBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
end)
reopenBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    reopenBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
    if reopenBtn:GetAttribute("_Moved") then return end
    setHubVisible(true, true)
    if _G.KRIXSaveNow then pcall(_G.KRIXSaveNow) end
end)

xb.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    setHubVisible(false, true)
    if _G.KRIXSaveNow then pcall(_G.KRIXSaveNow) end
end)

_G._GhostccSetMinimized = function(mini)
    -- System minimize (config) — not a user gesture
    setHubVisible(not mini, false)
end
UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(i, g)
    if hubStale() then return end
    if _G._GhostccKeyCaptureActive and _G._GhostccKeyCaptureActive() then return end
    local isKey = i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard
    local isPad = _isGamepadInput(i)
    if not isKey and not isPad then return end

    local toggleKey = Keybinds.UIToggle
    local hitToggle = (toggleKey ~= nil and toggleKey ~= Enum.KeyCode.Unknown and i.KeyCode == toggleKey)
    local hitStart = isPad and i.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonStart
    if not hitToggle and not hitStart then return end

    -- Do not require gameProcessedEvent == false: after the hub is closed,
    -- some executors still mark keys as processed and blocked reopening.
    local currentlyOpen = (_hubShown == true) and outer and outer.Visible == true
    if gui and gui.Parent then gui.Enabled = true end
    setHubVisible(not currentlyOpen, true)
end)

local pb = Instance.new("Frame", gui)
pb.Name = "StealBar"
pb.Size = UDim2.new(0, 324, 0, 58)
pb.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
pb.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -24)
pb.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(12, 12, 14)
pb.BackgroundTransparency = 0

local function sbRadiusText(value)
    local text = string.format("%.1f", tonumber(value) or 0)
    return (text:gsub("%.0$", ""))
end
local function sbAimbotSpeed()
    local fam = Spd and Spd.family
    if fam == "lagger" then return tonumber(_G._VezyBatAimbotSpeedLagger) or 40 end
    return tonumber(_G._VezyBatAimbotSpeed) or 58
end
local function sbModeText()
    if _G._VezyBatAimbotOn == true then
        return "AIMBOT " .. sbRadiusText(sbAimbotSpeed()) .. " SPEED"
    end
    local mode = "Normal"
    if false then
        local radius = tonumber(_G._VynxStealRadiusSemi) or 8.7
        return "SEMI " .. sbRadiusText(radius) .. " RADIUS"
    end
    local radius = tonumber(_G._VynxStealRadiusNormal) or tonumber(Settings.StealRadius) or 62
    return "NORMAL " .. sbRadiusText(radius) .. " RADIUS"
end

local Stats = game:GetService("Stats")
task.spawn(function()
    -- Count rendered frames over a short window using the official RenderStepped dt.
    -- tick()-delta sampling often clamps near 60 on some executors (e.g. Delta).
    local fpsAvg = 60
    local fpsFrames, fpsElapsed = 0, 0
    RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(dt)
        if hubStale() then return end
        dt = tonumber(dt) or 0
        if dt <= 0 or dt > 1 then return end
        fpsFrames = fpsFrames + 1
        fpsElapsed = fpsElapsed + dt
        if fpsElapsed >= 0.5 then
            fpsAvg = fpsFrames / fpsElapsed
            fpsFrames = 0
            fpsElapsed = 0
        end
    end))
    local pingSmooth = nil
    while pb.Parent do
        -- Prefer GetNetworkPing (matches client/shift-F3 style). Data Ping is often
        -- ~20-40ms higher and is only used as a fallback.
        local ping = 0
        pcall(function()
            local v = LocalPlayer:GetNetworkPing()
            if type(v) == "number" and v > 0 then
                ping = v * 1000
            end
        end)
        if ping <= 0 then
            pcall(function()
                local stat = Stats.Network.ServerStatsItem["Data Ping"]
                if not stat then return end
                local raw = stat:GetValue()
                if type(raw) == "number" then
                    ping = raw
                elseif type(raw) == "string" then
                    ping = tonumber((raw:gsub("[^%d%.]", ""))) or 0
                end
            end)
        end
        if ping > 0 then
            if pingSmooth == nil then
                pingSmooth = ping
            else
                pingSmooth = pingSmooth * 0.65 + ping * 0.35
            end
        end
        local show = pingSmooth or ping
        sbFps.Text = string.format("FPS: %d", math.floor(fpsAvg + 0.5))
        sbPing.Text = string.format("PING: %dms", math.floor((show or 0) + 0.5))
        sbMode.Text = sbModeText()
        task.wait(0.4)
    end
end)

do
    local dragging, dStart, sPos, activeInp
    pb.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if _G._VynxUILocked then return end
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragging = true; dStart = input.Position; sPos = pb.Position; activeInp = input
        end
    end)
    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if not dragging then return end
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
            or (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch and input == activeInp) then
            local d = input.Position - dStart
            pb.Position = UDim2.new(sPos.X.Scale, sPos.X.Offset + d.X, sPos.Y.Scale, sPos.Y.Offset + d.Y)
        end
    end)
    UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if not dragging then return end
        if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch
            and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then return end
        dragging = false; activeInp = nil
        local p = pb.Position
        _G._VlPbPos = {p.X.Scale, p.X.Offset, p.Y.Scale, p.Y.Offset}
        if _G.KRIXSaveNow then pcall(_G.KRIXSaveNow) end
    end)
end

local sbFillTween, sbResetTween
local function ResetProgressBar()
    pctMiniLbl.Text = "0%"
    if sbFillTween then pcall(function() sbFillTween:Cancel() end); sbFillTween = nil end
    if sbResetTween then pcall(function() sbResetTween:Cancel() end) end
    sbResetTween = TweenService:Create(ProgressBarFill,
        TweenInfo.new(0.06, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
        { Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1) })
    sbResetTween:Play()
end

_G.StealBar = {
    SetProgress = function(v)
        v = math.clamp(tonumber(v) or 0, 0, 1)
        if sbFillTween then pcall(function() sbFillTween:Cancel() end); sbFillTween = nil end
        ProgressBarFill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(v, 1)
        ProgressBarFill.BackgroundColor3 = _G._GhostccAccent or ACC
        pctMiniLbl.Text = math.floor(v * 100 + 0.5) .. "%"
    end,
    SetState = function() end,
    Reset = function() ResetProgressBar() end,
}


local function hkb(kc)
    if _G._GhostccKeyCaptureActive and _G._GhostccKeyCaptureActive() then return end
    if waitingForKey then return end

    if kc == Enum.KeyCode.Unknown then return end

    do
        local irKeyName = _G._VynxInstaResetKey
        if (Keybinds.InstaReset and Keybinds.InstaReset ~= Enum.KeyCode.Unknown
                and kc == Keybinds.InstaReset)
            or (irKeyName and kc.Name == irKeyName) then
            if _G.VynxDoInstaReset then _G.VynxDoInstaReset() end
            return
        end
    end

    if kc == Keybinds.SpeedToggle then
        Spd.Carry()
    elseif kc == Keybinds.LaggerToggle or kc == Keybinds.LaggerSpeed then
        Spd.Lagger()
    elseif kc == Keybinds.NormalSpeed then
        Spd.Normal()
    end
    if kc == Keybinds.AutoBat then

        if batClk then batClk(not (_G._VezyBatAimbotOn or false)) end
        if _G.KRIXSaveNow then _G.KRIXSaveNow() end
    end
    if kc == Keybinds.InfiniteJump then
        Enabled.InfiniteJump = not Enabled.InfiniteJump
        if VisualSetters.InfiniteJump then VisualSetters.InfiniteJump(Enabled.InfiniteJump) end
        if Enabled.InfiniteJump then startInfiniteJump() else stopInfiniteJump() end
        if _G.KRIXSaveNow then _G.KRIXSaveNow() end
    end
    if kc == Keybinds.DropBrainrot then
        if setDropBrainrotVisual then setDropBrainrotVisual(true) end
        task.spawn(runDropBrainrot)
    end

    if kc == Keybinds.TPDown then if _G._VynxRunTPDown then pcall(_G._VynxRunTPDown) end end

end
UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(i,g)
    if hubStale() then return end
    if g then return end
    if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then hkb(i.KeyCode)
    elseif _isGamepadInput(i) then hkb(i.KeyCode) end
end)

;(function()
local function applyUIScale(val)
    local prevScale = (UI_SCALE or 1) * DEVICE_UI_SCALE
    UI_SCALE = math.clamp(val, 0.5, 2.0)
    local newScale = UI_SCALE * DEVICE_UI_SCALE

    local function recentre()
        if not outer or prevScale == newScale then return end
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        local vp  = cam and cam.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1280, 720)
        local baseW, baseH = outer.Size.X.Offset, outer.Size.Y.Offset
        if baseW <= 0 or baseH <= 0 then return end

        local p  = outer.Position
        local ox = p.X.Offset - baseW * (newScale - prevScale) / 2
        local oy = p.Y.Offset - baseH * (newScale - prevScale) / 2

        local w, h = baseW * newScale, baseH * newScale
        local minX, minY = 8 - p.X.Scale * vp.X, 8 - p.Y.Scale * vp.Y
        ox = math.clamp(ox, minX, math.max(minX, vp.X - w - 8 - p.X.Scale * vp.X))
        oy = math.clamp(oy, minY, math.max(minY, vp.Y - h - 8 - p.Y.Scale * vp.Y))
        outer.Position = UDim2.new(p.X.Scale, ox, p.Y.Scale, oy)
    end

    local function applyToFrame(frame)
        if not frame then return end
        local s = frame:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
        if not s then s = Instance.new("UIScale"); s.Parent = frame end
        s.Scale = UI_SCALE * DEVICE_UI_SCALE
    end
    local function doApply()
        applyToFrame(outer)
        recentre()
        if not apMain then return end
        if apMain:IsDescendantOf(outer) then
            local s = apMain:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
            if s then s.Scale = 1 end
        else
            applyToFrame(apMain)
        end
    end
    if outer then doApply()
    else task.spawn(function() repeat task.wait(0.05) until outer and apMain; doApply() end) end
end

_G._VynxApplyUIScale = applyUIScale

if UI_SCALE then pcall(applyUIScale, UI_SCALE) end
local function loadConfig()

    local fname = nil
    if isfile and isfile("VynxHubConfig.json") then
        fname = "VynxHubConfig.json"
    elseif isfile and isfile("Velt7Config.json") then
        fname = "Velt7Config.json"
    end
    if not fname then return end
    local ok,cfg = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(readfile(fname)) end)
    if not ok or not cfg then
        return
    end

    NORMAL_SPEED = 59.5
    CARRY_SPEED  = 28.5
    if cfg.laggerSpeed then LAGGER_SPEED = cfg.laggerSpeed end
    if cfg.fovValue then FOV_VALUE = cfg.fovValue end

    if cfg.uiScalePercent and type(cfg.uiScalePercent) == "number" then
        local savedScale = math.clamp(cfg.uiScalePercent / 100, 0.5, 2.0)
        UI_SCALE = savedScale; applyUIScale(savedScale)
    else
        UI_SCALE = 1.0; applyUIScale(1.0)
    end

    if cfg.mobileBtnScale and type(cfg.mobileBtnScale) == "number" then
        _G._VynxMobileBtnScale = math.clamp(cfg.mobileBtnScale, 0.7, 2.0)
        if _G._VynxApplyMobileBtnScale then pcall(_G._VynxApplyMobileBtnScale, _G._VynxMobileBtnScale) end
        if _G._VynxRefreshMobileBtnSizeButtons then pcall(_G._VynxRefreshMobileBtnSizeButtons) end
    end

    if cfg.batAimbotMode and (cfg.batAimbotMode == "old" or cfg.batAimbotMode == "new") then
        _G._VezyBatAimbotMode = cfg.batAimbotMode
        if _G._VynxRefreshAimbotModeBtns then pcall(_G._VynxRefreshAimbotModeBtns) end
    end

    if cfg.customFOVOn ~= nil then
        if VisualSetters.CustomFOV then
            pcall(VisualSetters.CustomFOV, cfg.customFOVOn, true)
        end
        if cfg.customFOVOn then
            if _G.VezyEnableFOV then pcall(_G.VezyEnableFOV) end
        else
            if _G.VezyDisableFOV then pcall(_G.VezyDisableFOV) end
        end
    end
    if cfg.autoBatKey and Enum.KeyCode[cfg.autoBatKey] then Keybinds.AutoBat = Enum.KeyCode[cfg.autoBatKey] end
    if cfg.speedToggleKey and Enum.KeyCode[cfg.speedToggleKey] then Keybinds.SpeedToggle = Enum.KeyCode[cfg.speedToggleKey] end
    if cfg.laggerToggleKey and Enum.KeyCode[cfg.laggerToggleKey] then Keybinds.LaggerToggle = Enum.KeyCode[cfg.laggerToggleKey] end
    if cfg.infiniteJumpKey and Enum.KeyCode[cfg.infiniteJumpKey] then Keybinds.InfiniteJump = Enum.KeyCode[cfg.infiniteJumpKey] end
    if cfg.uiToggle and Enum.KeyCode[cfg.uiToggle] then Keybinds.UIToggle = Enum.KeyCode[cfg.uiToggle] end
    if cfg.grabRadius then

        if cfg.grabRadius == 55 or cfg.grabRadius == 8 then cfg.grabRadius = 62 end
        Settings.StealRadius = cfg.grabRadius; Values.STEAL_RADIUS = cfg.grabRadius
    end
    if cfg.stealDuration then

        if cfg.stealDuration == 1.50 or cfg.stealDuration == 0.19 then cfg.stealDuration = 1.30 end
        Settings.StealDuration = STEAL_DURATION_FIXED; Values.STEAL_DURATION = STEAL_DURATION_FIXED
    end
    if cfg.antiRagdoll ~= nil then Enabled.AntiRagdoll = cfg.antiRagdoll end

    if cfg.autoStealEnabled ~= nil then
        Enabled.AutoSteal = cfg.autoStealEnabled
        Settings.AutoStealEnabled = cfg.autoStealEnabled
    else
        Enabled.AutoSteal = true
        Settings.AutoStealEnabled = true
    end
    if cfg.infiniteJump ~= nil then Enabled.InfiniteJump = cfg.infiniteJump end
    if cfg.optimizer ~= nil then Enabled.Optimizer = cfg.optimizer end
    if cfg.unwalk ~= nil then Enabled.Unwalk = cfg.unwalk end
    if cfg.removeAccessories ~= nil then Enabled.RemoveAccessories = cfg.removeAccessories end

    if cfg.tpDownOffset then TP_DOWN_OFFSET = cfg.tpDownOffset end
        if cfg.autoTpDown ~= nil then

;(function()

local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")

local SETTINGS_FILE = "KrixDesync_settings.json"

local desyncActive = false
local function setDesync(state) desyncActive = state and true or false end
local waitingForKey = false
local toggleKey = Enum.KeyCode.Y

local unwalkActive = false
local unwalkConn = nil

local winPos = UDim2.new(0, 20, 1, -195)

local function saveSettings()
    local ok = pcall(function()
        local cfg = {
            hotkey = toggleKey.Name,
            winX = winPos.X.Offset,
            winY = winPos.Y.Offset,
            winXS = winPos.X.Scale,
            winYS = winPos.Y.Scale,
        }

        local parts = {}
        for k, v in pairs(cfg) do
            local vStr = (type(v) == "string") and ('"' .. v .. '"') or tostring(v)
            table.insert(parts, '"' .. k .. '":' .. vStr)
        end
        writefile(SETTINGS_FILE, "{" .. table.concat(parts, ",") .. "}")
    end)
end

local function loadSettings()
    pcall(function()
        local ok, data = pcall(readfile, SETTINGS_FILE)
        if not ok or not data or data == "" then return end
        local function toVal(s)
            s = s:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
            if s:sub(1, 1) == '"' then return s:sub(2, -2) end
            return tonumber(s)
        end
        for k, v in data:gmatch('"([^"]+)"%s*:%s*("?[^",}]+"?)') do
            local val = toVal(v)
            if k == "hotkey" and type(val) == "string" then
                local kc = Enum.KeyCode[val]
                if kc then toggleKey = kc end
            elseif k == "winX" then winPos = UDim2.new(winPos.X.Scale, val, winPos.Y.Scale, winPos.Y.Offset)
            elseif k == "winY" then winPos = UDim2.new(winPos.X.Scale, winPos.X.Offset, winPos.Y.Scale, val)
            elseif k == "winXS" then winPos = UDim2.new(val, winPos.X.Offset, winPos.Y.Scale, winPos.Y.Offset)
            elseif k == "winYS" then winPos = UDim2.new(winPos.X.Scale, winPos.X.Offset, val, winPos.Y.Offset)
            end
        end
    end)
end
loadSettings()

local function startUnwalkLoop() end

local function setUnwalk(state, btn)
    if state then
        unwalkActive = true
        startUnwalkLoop()
        if btn then
            tween(btn, 0.25, {
                BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(235, 235, 235),
                TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
            })
            btn.Text = "UNWALK: ON"
        end
    else
        unwalkActive = false
        if unwalkConn then
            unwalkConn:Disconnect()
            unwalkConn = nil
        end
        if btn then
            tween(btn, 0.25, {
                BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 35, 35),
                TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 240)
            })
            btn.Text = "UNWALK: OFF"
        end
    end
end

local ScreenGui, Panel, KeyBtn, keyStroke, UnwalkBtn, PANEL_W, PANEL_H = buildUI()

UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gpe)
    if hubStale() then return end
    if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard
       and true
       and not _isGamepadInput(input) then return end

    if waitingForKey then
        if gpe then return end
        toggleKey = input.KeyCode
        if KeyBtn then KeyBtn.Text = "[ " .. toggleKey.Name .. " ]" end
        if keyStroke then tween(keyStroke, 0.2, {Color = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 60), Thickness = 1}) end
        waitingForKey = false
        saveSettings()
        return
    end

    if gpe then return end
    if _G._GhostccKeyCaptureActive and _G._GhostccKeyCaptureActive() then return end
    if input.KeyCode == toggleKey then
        setDesync(not desyncActive)
        if updateVisual then updateVisual() end
    end
end)

_G.KrixDesyncToggle = function(on)
    setDesync(on and true or false)
    if updateVisual then updateVisual() end
end


_G.KrixDesyncShowPanel = function()
    Panel.Visible = true
    Panel.Size = UDim2.new(0, PANEL_W, 0, 0)
    Panel.Position = UDim2.new(winPos.X.Scale, winPos.X.Offset, winPos.Y.Scale, winPos.Y.Offset + (PANEL_H / 2))
    TS:Create(Panel, TweenInfo.new(0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
        Size = UDim2.new(0, PANEL_W, 0, PANEL_H),
        Position = winPos
    }):Play()
end

_G.KrixDesyncHidePanel = function()
    TS:Create(Panel, TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {
        Size = UDim2.new(0, PANEL_W, 0, 0)
    }):Play()
    task.delay(0.27, function() Panel.Visible = false end)
end

_G.KrixDesyncTogglePanel = function()
    if Panel.Visible then
        _G.KrixDesyncHidePanel()
    else
        _G.KrixDesyncShowPanel()
    end
end

end)()

-- Each asset is a single letter, spelling GHOST from left to right.

    -- Ghost Duel intro transplanted from the reference file; SKIP remains the
    -- dedicated top-right button and the intro waits for its completion.
    local Players = game:GetService("Players")
    local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

    local ghostMusicRequest = 0

        ghostMusicRequest = ghostMusicRequest + 1
        if ghostCurrentMusicSound then
            pcall(function() ghostCurrentMusicSound:Stop() end)
            pcall(function() ghostCurrentMusicSound:Destroy() end)
            ghostCurrentMusicSound = nil
        end
    end
-- GHOST DUEL INTRO (intro động: nhân vật, kính vỡ, xích, tiền rơi,

----------------------------------------------------------------
if _G.GhostDuelIntroEnabled ~= false then

	local PC_AUTO_FIT = true -- PC: tự phóng to / thu nhỏ theo độ phân giải (2K, 4K sẽ to ra tương ứng)
	local PC_MIN_SCALE, PC_MAX_SCALE = 0.75, 2.2 -- giới hạn kích cỡ khi tự canh trên PC

	-- Nhận biết PC hay điện thoại rồi chọn kích cỡ phù hợp
	local function getViewport()
		local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
		local t0 = os.clock()
		while (not cam or cam.ViewportSize.Y < 2) and os.clock() - t0 < 3 do
			task.wait()
			cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
		end
		return cam and cam.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1920, 1080)
	end
	local function isPC()
		local ok, pc = pcall(function()
			if UIS.KeyboardEnabled and UIS.MouseEnabled then return true end
			return not UIS.TouchEnabled
		end)
		return ok and pc
	end
	local INTRO_SCALE = INTRO_SCALE_MOBILE
	if isPC() then
		INTRO_SCALE = INTRO_SCALE_PC
		if PC_AUTO_FIT then
			local vp = getViewport()
			local fit = math.min(vp.X / 1920, vp.Y / 1080)
			INTRO_SCALE = math.clamp(INTRO_SCALE_PC * fit, PC_MIN_SCALE, PC_MAX_SCALE)
		end
	end
	local GHOST_DUEL_X = 0.72 -- vị trí ngang của chữ "Ghost Duel" (0 = trái, 0.5 = giữa, 1 = phải)

	-- Ảnh chữ "Ghost Duel" / "Ghost Duel" / giấy báo "GHOST DUEL" (nhúng sẵn, tự lưu vào máy)
	local IMG_VERSION = "v9"

	--============================================================

	--============================================================
	local function b64decode(data)
		local ok, out = pcall(function()
			local f = (crypt and (crypt.base64decode or (crypt.base64 and crypt.base64.decode)))
				or base64_decode
				or (base64 and base64.decode)
				or (syn and syn.crypt and syn.crypt.base64 and syn.crypt.base64.decode)
			if f then return f(data) end
		end)
		if ok and type(out) == "string" and #out > 100 then return out end
		local alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
		local map = {}
		for i = 1, 64 do map[string.byte(alphabet, i)] = i - 1 end
		data = string.gsub(data, "[^%w%+/]", "")
		local res, n = {}, 0
		local byte, char, floor = string.byte, string.char, math.floor
		for i = 1, #data, 4 do
			local a, b, c, d = byte(data, i, i + 3)
			a, b = map[a], map[b]
			c = c and map[c]
			d = d and map[d]
			local v = a * 262144 + b * 4096 + (c or 0) * 64 + (d or 0)
			local b1, b2, b3 = floor(v / 65536) % 256, floor(v / 256) % 256, v % 256
			n = n + 1
			if d then
				res[n] = char(b1, b2, b3)
			elseif c then
				res[n] = char(b1, b2)
			else
				res[n] = char(b1)
			end
		end
		return table.concat(res)
	end

	-- Ảnh nhúng -> writefile -> getcustomasset (lỗi thì trả về nil)
	local function embeddedAsset(file, data)
		local asset
		pcall(function()
			if isfile and isfile(file) then asset = getcustomasset(file) end
		end)
		if asset then return asset end
		local ok, bytes = pcall(b64decode, data)
		if not ok or type(bytes) ~= "string" or #bytes < 100 then return nil end
		pcall(function() writefile(file, bytes) end)
		pcall(function() asset = getcustomasset(file) end)
		return asset
	end

	-- Tải file từ link -> getcustomasset (có cache bằng writefile)
	local function loadUrlAsset(url, file)
		if not url or url == "" then return nil end
		local asset
		pcall(function()
			if isfile and isfile(file) then asset = getcustomasset(file) end
		end)
		if asset then return asset end
		local ok, data = pcall(function() return game:HttpGet(url) end)
		if ok and data and #data > 1000 then
			pcall(function() writefile(file, data) end)
			pcall(function() asset = getcustomasset(file) end)
		end
		return asset
	end

	local function playTimeline(segments, options, onDone)
    options = options or {}
    local runService = game:GetService("RunService")
    local soundService = game:GetService("SoundService")
    local players = game:GetService("Players")
    local playerGui = options.target or players.LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
    local globalEnv = _G
    pcall(function()
        if type(getgenv) == "function" then
            local candidate = getgenv()
            if type(candidate) == "table" then globalEnv = candidate end
        end
    end)

    local KEY = "__GHOST_DUEL_INTRO_PLAYBACK_V1"
    pcall(function()
        local previous = globalEnv[KEY]
        if type(previous) == "table" and type(previous.stop) == "function" then previous.stop() end
    end)

    local state = {stopped = false, objects = {}, sounds = {}, soundLoads = {}, pending = {}}
    pcall(function() globalEnv[KEY] = state end)

    local function destroySound(id)
        local con = state.soundLoads[id]
        if con then pcall(function() con:Disconnect() end); state.soundLoads[id] = nil end
        local sound = state.sounds[id]
        state.sounds[id] = nil
        if sound then
            pcall(function() sound:Stop() end)
            pcall(function() sound:Destroy() end)
        end
    end
    local function clearSegment()
        local soundIds = {}
        for id in pairs(state.sounds) do soundIds[#soundIds + 1] = id end
        for _, id in ipairs(soundIds) do destroySound(id) end
        for _, object in pairs(state.objects) do pcall(function() object:Destroy() end) end
        state.objects, state.pending = {}, {}
    end
    function state.stop()
        if state.stopped then return end
        state.stopped = true
        clearSegment()
        pcall(function() if globalEnv[KEY] == state then globalEnv[KEY] = nil end end)
        if onDone then pcall(onDone) end
    end

    local function decode(value)
        if type(value) ~= "table" then return value, true end
        local tag = value[1]
        if tag == "nil" then return nil, true end
        if tag == "ref" then
            local object = state.objects[value[2]]
            return object, object ~= nil
        end
        if tag == "num" then
            if value[2] == "inf" then return math.huge, true end
            if value[2] == "-inf" then return -math.huge, true end
            return 0/0, true
        end
        if tag == "enum" then return Enum[value[2]][value[3]], true end
        if tag == "color3" then return Color3.new(value[2], value[3], value[4]), true end
        if tag == "udim" then return UDim.new(value[2], value[3]), true end
        if tag == "udim2" then return UDim2.new(value[2], value[3], value[4], value[5]), true end
        if tag == "vector2" then return Vector2.new(value[2], value[3]), true end
        if tag == "vector3" then return Vector3.new(value[2], value[3], value[4]), true end
        if tag == "vector2i" then return Vector2int16.new(value[2], value[3]), true end
        if tag == "vector3i" then return Vector3int16.new(value[2], value[3], value[4]), true end
        if tag == "rect" then return Rect.new(value[2], value[3], value[4], value[5]), true end
        if tag == "range" then return NumberRange.new(value[2], value[3]), true end
        if tag == "brick" then return BrickColor.new(value[2]), true end
        if tag == "cframe" then return CFrame.new(table.unpack(value, 2, 13)), true end
        if tag == "font" then return Font.fromEnum(Enum.Font.Creepster), true end
        if tag == "colorseq" then
            local points = {}
            for _, p in ipairs(value[2]) do
                points[#points + 1] = ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(p[1], Color3.new(p[2], p[3], p[4]))
            end
            return ColorSequence.new(points), true
        end
        if tag == "numberseq" then
            local points = {}
            for _, p in ipairs(value[2]) do
                points[#points + 1] = NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(p[1], p[2], p[3])
            end
            return NumberSequence.new(points), true
        end
        if tag == "physical" then
            return PhysicalProperties.new(value[2], value[3], value[4], value[5], value[6]), true
        end
        return nil, false
    end
    local function safeDecode(encoded)
        local ok, value, ready = pcall(decode, encoded)
        if not ok then return nil, false end
        return value, ready
    end
    local blocked = {Active = true, Modal = true, Interactable = true, TextEditable = true}
    -- Thu nhỏ toàn bộ intro (kích thước, chữ, bo góc, viền) theo options.scale
    local SCALE = tonumber(options.scale) or 1
    state.parentOf = {}
    local function isTopLevel(id)
        local p = state.parentOf[id]
        if p == nil or p == 0 then return true end
        local pp = state.parentOf[p]
        if pp == nil or pp == 0 then return true end
        return state.parentOf[pp] == 0
    end
    local function scaleValue(id, property, value)
        if SCALE == 1 then return value end
        local t = typeof(value)
        if t == "UDim2" and (property == "Size" or (property == "Position" and not isTopLevel(id))) then
            return UDim2.new(value.X.Scale, math.floor(value.X.Offset * SCALE + 0.5), value.Y.Scale, math.floor(value.Y.Offset * SCALE + 0.5))
        elseif property == "TextSize" and type(value) == "number" then
            return math.max(6, math.floor(value * SCALE + 0.5))
        elseif t == "UDim" and (property == "CornerRadius" or property == "Padding") then
            return UDim.new(value.Scale, math.floor(value.Offset * SCALE + 0.5))
        elseif property == "Thickness" and type(value) == "number" then
            return value * SCALE
        end
        return value
    end
    local function applyProperty(id, property, encoded)
        local object = state.objects[id]
        if not object or blocked[property] then return end
        local pendingForObject = state.pending[id]
        if pendingForObject then pendingForObject[property] = nil end
        local value, ready = safeDecode(encoded)
        if not ready then
            if type(encoded) == "table" and encoded[1] == "ref" then
                state.pending[id] = state.pending[id] or {}
                state.pending[id][property] = encoded
            end
            return
        end
        local okScale, scaled = pcall(scaleValue, id, property, value)
        if okScale then value = scaled end
        pcall(function() object[property] = value end)
    end
    local function flushPending()
        for id, props in pairs(state.pending) do
            if not state.objects[id] then
                state.pending[id] = nil
            else
                for prop, encoded in pairs(props) do
                    local value, ready = safeDecode(encoded)
                    if ready then
                        pcall(function() state.objects[id][prop] = value end)
                        props[prop] = nil
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    local function makeNonBlocking(object)
        pcall(function() if object:IsA("GuiObject") then object.Active = false end end)
        pcall(function() if object:IsA("GuiObject") then object.Interactable = false end end)
        pcall(function() if object:IsA("GuiButton") then object.Modal = false end end)
        pcall(function() if object:IsA("TextBox") then object.TextEditable = false end end)
    end
    local function seekSound(sound, position)
        pcall(function()
            local length = sound.TimeLength
            if length > 0 and sound.Looped then position = position % length end
            if length > 0 and not sound.Looped then position = math.min(position, math.max(0, length - 0.001)) end
            sound.TimePosition = math.max(0, position)
        end)
    end
    local function startSound(id, data)
        destroySound(id)
        local ok, sound = pcall(Instance.new, "Sound")
        if not ok or not sound then return end
        state.sounds[id] = sound
        pcall(function() sound:SetAttribute("WID_Internal_V3", true) end)
        pcall(function() sound.SoundId = data.id or "" end)
        pcall(function() sound.Volume = data.volume or 0 end)
        pcall(function() sound.PlaybackSpeed = data.speed or 1 end)
        pcall(function() sound.Looped = data.looped == true end)
        pcall(function() sound.Parent = soundService end)
        local requestedAt = os.clock()
        pcall(function() sound:Play() end)
        local startPosition = tonumber(data.position) or 0
        if startPosition > 0.001 then
            seekSound(sound, startPosition)
            local isLoaded = false
            pcall(function() isLoaded = sound.IsLoaded end)
            if not isLoaded then
                local connection
                local okConnect = pcall(function()
                    connection = sound.Loaded:Connect(function()
                        if connection then connection:Disconnect(); state.soundLoads[id] = nil end
                        if not state.stopped and state.sounds[id] == sound then
                            local speed = tonumber(data.speed) or 1
                            seekSound(sound, startPosition + (os.clock() - requestedAt) * speed)
                        end
                    end)
                end)
                if okConnect and connection then state.soundLoads[id] = connection end
            end
        end
    end
    local function apply(event)
        local op, id = event[2], event[3]
        if op == "N" then
            local ok, object = pcall(Instance.new, event[4])
            if not ok or not object then return end
            if state.objects[id] then pcall(function() state.objects[id]:Destroy() end) end
            state.objects[id] = object
            state.parentOf[id] = event[5]
            if event[5] == 0 then pcall(function() object:SetAttribute("WID_Internal_V3", true) end) end
            for property, encoded in pairs(event[6] or {}) do applyProperty(id, property, encoded) end
            for name, encoded in pairs(event[7] or {}) do
                local value, ready = safeDecode(encoded)
                if ready then pcall(function() object:SetAttribute(name, value) end) end
            end
            makeNonBlocking(object)
            local parent = event[5] == 0 and playerGui or state.objects[event[5]]
            if parent then pcall(function() object.Parent = parent end) end
            flushPending()
        elseif op == "P" then
            for property, encoded in pairs(event[4] or {}) do applyProperty(id, property, encoded) end
        elseif op == "A" then
            local object = state.objects[id]
            local value, ready = safeDecode(event[5])
            if object and ready then pcall(function() object:SetAttribute(event[4], value) end) end
        elseif op == "M" then
            local object = state.objects[id]
            local parent = event[4] == 0 and playerGui or state.objects[event[4]]
            if object and parent then state.parentOf[id] = event[4]; pcall(function() object.Parent = parent end) end
        elseif op == "D" then
            local object = state.objects[id]
            state.objects[id], state.pending[id] = nil, nil
            if object then pcall(function() object:Destroy() end) end
        elseif op == "S" then
            startSound(id, event[4] or {})
        elseif op == "U" then
            local sound = state.sounds[id]
            if sound then
                local data = event[4] or {}
                if data.volume ~= nil then pcall(function() sound.Volume = data.volume end) end
                if data.speed ~= nil then pcall(function() sound.PlaybackSpeed = data.speed end) end
                if data.looped ~= nil then pcall(function() sound.Looped = data.looped end) end
                if data.id ~= nil then pcall(function() sound.SoundId = data.id end) end
            end
        elseif op == "K" then
            local sound = state.sounds[id]
            if sound then seekSound(sound, event[4] or 0) end
        elseif op == "Q" then
            destroySound(id)
        end
    end

    task.spawn(function()
        local ok, err = xpcall(function()
            for _, segment in ipairs(segments) do
                if state.stopped then break end
                local events = segment.events or {}
                local duration = math.max(0, tonumber(segment.duration) or 0)
                local startedAt, index = os.clock(), 1
                while not state.stopped do
                    if state.skipping then break end
                    local elapsed = os.clock() - startedAt
                    while index <= #events and (tonumber(events[index][1]) or 0) <= elapsed do
                        apply(events[index])
                        index = index + 1
                    end
                    if elapsed >= duration and index > #events then break end
                    runService.Heartbeat:Wait()
                end
                if state.skipping then
                    while not state.stopped do runService.Heartbeat:Wait() end
                    break
                end
                clearSegment()
            end
        end, function(message) return tostring(message) end)
        if not ok then warn("[Ghost Duel Intro] Playback stopped: " .. tostring(err)) end
        state.stop()
    end)
    return state
end

	-- Chặn phần script chính cho đến khi người dùng bấm SKIP.
	local ghostIntroContinue = Instance.new("BindableEvent")
	local ghostIntroWasSkipped = false
	local ghostIntroEnded = false

	-- Gỡ màn đen đúng lúc intro kết thúc hoặc khi người dùng bấm SKIP.
	local function finishGhostIntroBlackScreen()
		if ghostIntroEnded then return end
		ghostIntroEnded = true
		pcall(function()
			if ghostIntroBlackCover and ghostIntroBlackCover.Parent then
				ghostIntroBlackCover:Destroy()
			end
		end)
		pcall(function() ghostIntroContinue:Fire() end)
	end

	--============================================================
	-- START INTRO
	--============================================================
	task.spawn(function()
		local ok, err = pcall(function()
			local logoTop = embeddedAsset("GhostDuelIntro_LogoTop_" .. IMG_VERSION .. ".png", LOGO_TOP_B64)
			local logoBottom = embeddedAsset("GhostDuelIntro_LogoBottom_" .. IMG_VERSION .. ".png", LOGO_BOTTOM_B64)
			local paper = embeddedAsset("GhostDuelIntro_Paper_" .. IMG_VERSION .. ".png", PAPER_B64)
			local music = (MUSIC_ID ~= "" and MUSIC_ID) or loadUrlAsset(MUSIC_URL, MUSIC_FILE) or ""

			-- Dời chữ "Ghost Duel" sang bên phải nhân vật ở giữa
			local ghostDuelIds = {}
			local function moveOnTop(pos)
				if type(pos) == "table" and pos[1] == "udim2" then pos[2] = GHOST_DUEL_X end
			end

			for _, segment in ipairs(_segments) do
				for _, ev in ipairs(segment.events or {}) do
					local op = ev[2]
					if op == "P" and ghostDuelIds[ev[3]] and type(ev[4]) == "table" then
						moveOnTop(ev[4].Position)
					end
					if op == "N" and type(ev[6]) == "table" then
						local props = ev[6]
						if props.Image == ORIGINAL_LOGO_BOTTOM then
							ghostDuelIds[ev[3]] = true
							moveOnTop(props.Position)
						end
						if props.Name == "SpotifyFrame" then
							props.Visible = false -- ẩn khung nhạc góc phải
						end
						if ev[4] == "ScreenGui" and ev[5] == 0 then
							props.Name = "GhostDuelIntro"
							props.DisplayOrder = 999999
						end
						local img = props.Image
						if type(img) == "string" then
							if img == ORIGINAL_LOGO_TOP and logoTop then
								props.Image = logoTop
							elseif img == ORIGINAL_LOGO_BOTTOM and logoBottom then
								props.Image = logoBottom
							elseif img == ORIGINAL_PAPER and paper then
								props.Image = paper
							elseif string.sub(img, 1, 9) == "rbxasset:" and string.sub(img, 1, 12) ~= "rbxassetid:/" then
								props.Image = "" -- file riêng của máy người làm intro gốc, không dùng được
							end
						end
					elseif op == "S" and type(ev[4]) == "table" then
						ev[4].id = music
						ev[4].volume = MUSIC_VOLUME
						ev[4].position = MUSIC_START
						ev[4].looped = false
					elseif op == "U" and type(ev[4]) == "table" and ev[4].volume ~= nil then
						ev[4].volume = (ev[4].volume / 10) * MUSIC_VOLUME
					end
				end
			end

			local state = playTimeline(_segments, { target = PlayerGui, scale = INTRO_SCALE })

            -- Apply the same diagonal purple/black shimmer to intro title text.
            if state then
                task.spawn(function()
                    local processed = {}
                    while not state.stopped and not ghostIntroEnded do
                        for _, obj in pairs(state.objects or {}) do
                            if obj and obj.Parent and (obj:IsA("TextLabel") or obj:IsA("TextButton")) and not processed[obj] then
                                local titleText = string.upper(tostring(obj.Text or ""))
                                if titleText:find("GHOST", 1, true) and (titleText:find("DUEL", 1, true) or titleText == "GHOST") then
                                    processed[obj] = true
                                    pcall(function()
                                        obj.TextTransparency = 0
                                        obj.TextStrokeTransparency = math.min(obj.TextStrokeTransparency, 0.15)
                                    end)
                                    applyGhostDuelShimmer(obj)
                                end
                            end
                        end
                        task.wait(0.12)
                    end
                end)
            end

			-- Nút SKIP riêng ở góc trên bên phải; không bỏ qua khi chạm màn hình bên ngoài.
			if ALLOW_SKIP and state then
				local skipGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
				skipGui.Name = "GhostDuelIntroSkip"
				skipGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
				skipGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
				skipGui.DisplayOrder = 1000000
				skipGui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
				skipGui.Parent = PlayerGui

				local skipButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
				skipButton.Name = "SkipButton"
				skipButton.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
				skipButton.Position = UDim2.new(1, -22, 0, 22)
				skipButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 88, 0, 34)
				skipButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(22, 23, 28)
				skipButton.BackgroundTransparency = 0.12
				skipButton.BorderSizePixel = 0
				skipButton.AutoButtonColor = true
				skipButton.Text = "SKIP  ›"
				skipButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(245, 245, 250)
				skipButton.TextSize = 13
				skipButton.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
				skipButton.ZIndex = 1000001
			skipButton.Parent = skipGui

				local skipCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
				skipCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 9)
				skipCorner.Parent = skipButton
				local skipStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
				skipStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(205, 208, 218)
				skipStroke.Thickness = 1.25
				skipStroke.Transparency = 0.12
				skipStroke.Parent = skipButton

				local originalStop = state.stop
				state.stop = function()
					-- Khi intro chạy hết tự nhiên, gỡ màn đen và cho script tiếp tục.
					finishGhostIntroBlackScreen()
					-- Remove SKIP whether the intro ends naturally or is skipped.
					if skipGui and skipGui.Parent then
						pcall(function() skipGui:Destroy() end)
					end
					originalStop()
				end

				local skipping = false
				skipButton.Activated:Connect(function()
					if skipping or state.skipping then return end
					skipping = true
					ghostIntroWasSkipped = true
					finishGhostIntroBlackScreen()
					state.skipping = true
					local info = TweenInfo.new(0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
					for _, obj in pairs(state.objects) do
						pcall(function()
							if obj:IsA("ImageLabel") or obj:IsA("ImageButton") then
								TS:Create(obj, info, { ImageTransparency = 1, BackgroundTransparency = 1 }):Play()
							elseif obj:IsA("TextLabel") or obj:IsA("TextButton") then
								TS:Create(obj, info, { TextTransparency = 1, BackgroundTransparency = 1 }):Play()
							elseif obj:IsA("Frame") then
								TS:Create(obj, info, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }):Play()
							elseif obj:IsA("UIStroke") then
								TS:Create(obj, info, { Transparency = 1 }):Play()
							end
						end)
					end
					for _, snd in pairs(state.sounds) do
						pcall(function() TS:Create(snd, info, { Volume = 0 }):Play() end)
					end
					pcall(function() TS:Create(skipButton, info, { BackgroundTransparency = 1, TextTransparency = 1 }):Play() end)
					pcall(function() TS:Create(skipStroke, info, { Transparency = 1 }):Play() end)
				task.delay(0.4, function() pcall(state.stop) end)
				end)
			end

		end)
		if not ok then
			warn("[Ghost Duel Intro] " .. tostring(err))
			finishGhostIntroBlackScreen()
			pcall(function()
				local g = PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("GhostDuelIntro")
				if g then g:Destroy() end
			end)
		end
	end)
	-- Chờ intro kết thúc tự nhiên hoặc người dùng bấm SKIP.
	if not ghostIntroEnded then
		ghostIntroContinue.Event:Wait()
	end
	pcall(function() ghostIntroContinue:Destroy() end)
	pcall(function()
		if ghostIntroBlackCover and ghostIntroBlackCover.Parent then
			ghostIntroBlackCover:Destroy()
		end
	end)
end

end -- GhostDuelIntroEnabled
    if onFinished then pcall(onFinished) end
end

task.defer(function()
    local hubGui = gui
    local hubRevealed = false
    local function revealHub()
        if hubRevealed then return end
        hubRevealed = true
        _G._GhostccIntroActive = false
        -- Never inherit a stale "hidden while intro was running" save.
        -- Only an explicit user hide keeps the hub closed after intro.
        _G._GhostccWantMinimized = (_G._GhostccUserHidHub == true)
        if hubGui then hubGui.Enabled = true end
        if _G._GhostccForceHudReveal then
            pcall(_G._GhostccForceHudReveal)
        else
            local stealBar = hubGui and hubGui:FindFirstChild("StealBar")
            if stealBar then stealBar.Visible = true end
            if _G._VynxApplyHideMobile then
                pcall(_G._VynxApplyHideMobile, _G._VezyHideSideBtns == true)
            elseif _G._VezyMobileButtonsFrame then
                _G._VezyMobileButtonsFrame.Visible = _G._VezyHideSideBtns ~= true
            end
            if _G._GhostccUserHidHub ~= true then
                local outerRef = _G.VynxOuterRef
                if outerRef and outerRef.Parent then
                    if _G._GhostccSetHubVisible then pcall(_G._GhostccSetHubVisible, true, false)
                    else outerRef.Visible = true end
                end
            end
        end
        if _G._GhostccRevealPanels then pcall(_G._GhostccRevealPanels) end
        -- Extra safety nets for executors (e.g. Delta) that delay ScreenGui parenting
        task.delay(0.35, function()
            if _G._GhostccForceHudReveal then pcall(_G._GhostccForceHudReveal, true) end
        end)
        task.delay(1.0, function()
            if _G._GhostccForceHudReveal then pcall(_G._GhostccForceHudReveal, true) end
        end)
    end

    if _G._GhostccSkipIntro == true then
        revealHub()
        return
    end

    _G._GhostccIntroActive = true
    if hubGui then hubGui.Enabled = false end
    for _, key in ipairs({ "duelLagger", "pingLagger", "speedBypass" }) do
        if _G._GhostccShowPanel then pcall(_G._GhostccShowPanel, key, false) end
    end
    playGhostLoadIntro(revealHub)
    -- Same completion safety net used by the reference script's intro waiters:
    -- a failed optional audio/tween callback can never leave the HUD hidden.
    task.delay(8, revealHub)
    task.delay(8.1, function()
        if _G._GhostccForceHudReveal then pcall(_G._GhostccForceHudReveal, true) end
    end)
end)




;(function()
    local Players     = game:GetService("Players")
    local RunService  = game:GetService("RunService")
    local LP          = Players.LocalPlayer

    local GHOST_COLOR   = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    local DISCORD_TEXT  = "discord.gg/son-hub"

    local selfSpeedLabel = nil
    local otherLabels = {}

    local function buildSelfTag(char)
        if not char then return end
        local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head") or char:WaitForChild("Head", 5)
        if not head then return end
        local old = head:FindFirstChild("GhostHeadBB")
        if old then old:Destroy() end

        local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui", head)
        bb.Name = "GhostHeadBB"
        bb.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(420, 86)
        bb.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 2.45, 0)
        bb.AlwaysOnTop = true
        bb.ResetOnSpawn = false
        bb.LightInfluence = 0
        bb.MaxDistance = 150

        local card = Instance.new("Frame", bb)
        card.Name = "GhostCard"
        card.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
        card.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        card.BorderSizePixel = 0

        local val = Instance.new("TextLabel", card)
        val.Name = "Speed"
        val.Size = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0.46, 0)
        val.Position = UDim2.new(0, 6, 0, 2)
        val.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        val.Text = "0.0"
        val.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
        val.TextScaled = true
        val.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        val.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.55
        val.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 8, 60)
        local vcon = Instance.new("UITextSizeConstraint", val)
        vcon.MinTextSize = 6
        vcon.MaxTextSize = 48


        local slogan = Instance.new("TextLabel", card)
        slogan.Name = "Slogan"
        slogan.Size = UDim2.new(1, -2, 0.58, 0)
        slogan.Position = UDim2.new(0, 1, 0.42, 0)
        slogan.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        slogan.Text = "discord.gg/son-hub"
        slogan.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        slogan.TextScaled = false
        slogan.TextSize = 13
        slogan.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        slogan.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.15
        slogan.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 5, 50)
        local scon = Instance.new("UITextSizeConstraint", slogan)
        scon.MinTextSize = 13
        scon.MaxTextSize = 13

        selfSpeedLabel = val
        -- Respawned tags pick up the current theme immediately
        if _G._GhostccSetTagColor and _G._GhostccAccent then
            pcall(_G._GhostccSetTagColor, _G._GhostccAccent)
        end
    end

    local function buildOtherTag(player)
        local char = player.Character
        if not char then return end
        local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
        if not head then return end
        local old = head:FindFirstChild("GhostSpeedBB")
        if old then old:Destroy() end

        local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if hum then
            pcall(function()
                hum.DisplayDistanceType = Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None
                hum.NameDisplayDistance = 0
                hum.HealthDisplayDistance = 0
            end)
        end

        local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui", head)
        bb.Name = "GhostSpeedBB"
        bb.Size = UDim2.fromScale(2.5, 1.02)
        bb.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 2.6, 0)
        bb.AlwaysOnTop = true
        bb.ResetOnSpawn = false
        bb.LightInfluence = 0
        bb.MaxDistance = 220

        local val = Instance.new("TextLabel", bb)
        val.Name = "Speed"
        val.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
        val.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        val.Text = "0"
        val.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
        val.TextScaled = true
        val.TextColor3 = GHOST_COLOR
        val.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
        val.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
        local con = Instance.new("UITextSizeConstraint", val)
        con.MinTextSize = 7
        con.MaxTextSize = 21

        otherLabels[player] = val
    end

    local function watchPlayer(player)
        if player == LP then return end
        if player.Character then task.spawn(function() task.wait(0.3); pcall(buildOtherTag, player) end) end
        player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
            task.wait(0.4)
            pcall(buildOtherTag, player)
        end)
    end

    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do watchPlayer(player) end
    Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(watchPlayer)
    Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player) otherLabels[player] = nil end)

    if LP.Character then
        task.spawn(function() task.wait(0.3); pcall(buildSelfTag, LP.Character) end)
    end
    LP.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
        task.wait(0.3)
        pcall(buildSelfTag, char)
    end)

    task.spawn(function()
        while task.wait(1) do
            local char = LP.Character
            local head = char and char:FindFirstChild("Head")
            if head and not head:FindFirstChild("GhostHeadBB") then
                pcall(buildSelfTag, char)
            end
            for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if player ~= LP then
                    local pc = player.Character
                    local ph = pc and pc:FindFirstChild("Head")
                    if ph and not ph:FindFirstChild("GhostSpeedBB") then
                        pcall(buildOtherTag, player)
                    elseif pc then
                        local phum = pc:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                        if phum and phum.DisplayDistanceType ~= Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None then
                            pcall(function()
                                phum.DisplayDistanceType = Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None
                                phum.NameDisplayDistance = 0
                                phum.HealthDisplayDistance = 0
                            end)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end)

    RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
        if selfSpeedLabel and selfSpeedLabel.Parent then
            local char = LP.Character
            local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local humanoid = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if hrp then
                local routing = (_G._GhostccAutoPathActive and _G._GhostccAutoPathActive()) or false
                local aimbotting = (_G._GhostccGetAimbotSpeed and _G._GhostccGetAimbotSpeed()) ~= nil
                if humanoid and not routing and not aimbotting
                    and humanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude == 0 then
                    if selfSpeedLabel.Text ~= "0.0" then selfSpeedLabel.Text = "0.0" end
                else
                    local vel = hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity
                    local horizontal = Vector3.new(vel.X, 0, vel.Z).Magnitude

                    local ceiling = 0
                    if not routing then
                        ceiling = tonumber(_G._GhostccGetSpeed and _G._GhostccGetSpeed()) or 0
                        if ceiling > 0 then
                            horizontal = (horizontal > 0.15) and ceiling or 0
                        end
                    end

                    if horizontal < 0.15 then horizontal = 0 end
                    local speedTxt = string.format("%.1f", horizontal)
                    if selfSpeedLabel.Text ~= speedTxt then selfSpeedLabel.Text = speedTxt end
                end
            end
        end

        local SPEED_TAG_NEAR = 24
        local SPEED_TAG_FAR  = 160
        local SPEED_TAG_MAX  = 1.9
        local speedTagCam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        local camCF = speedTagCam and speedTagCam.CFrame

        for player, label in pairs(otherLabels) do
            if label and label.Parent then
                local pc = player.Character
                local prp = pc and pc:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if prp then
                    local vel = prp.AssemblyLinearVelocity or prp.Velocity
                    local tagTxt = string.format("%d", math.floor(Vector3.new(vel.X, 0, vel.Z).Magnitude + 0.5))
                    if label.Text ~= tagTxt then label.Text = tagTxt end

                    local bb = label.Parent
                    if camCF and bb and bb:IsA("BillboardGui") then
                        local dist = (camCF.Position - prp.Position).Magnitude
                        local grow = math.clamp(dist / SPEED_TAG_NEAR, 1, SPEED_TAG_FAR / SPEED_TAG_NEAR)
                        grow = math.min(grow, SPEED_TAG_MAX)
                        local tagSize = UDim2.fromScale(2.5 * grow, 1.02 * grow)
                        if bb.Size ~= tagSize then bb.Size = tagSize end
                    end
                end
            else
                otherLabels[player] = nil
            end
        end
    end))

    _G._GhostccHeadTagColor = GHOST_COLOR
    _G._GhostccDiscordText = DISCORD_TEXT

    _G._GhostccSetTagColor = function(c)
        if typeof(c) ~= "Color3" then return end
        GHOST_COLOR = c
        _G._GhostccHeadTagColor = c
        if selfSpeedLabel and selfSpeedLabel.Parent then
            selfSpeedLabel.TextColor3 = c
            local card = selfSpeedLabel.Parent
            local disc = card:FindFirstChild("Discord")
            if disc then disc.TextColor3 = c end
            -- Billboard card: panel, outline, divider, slogan follow the theme
            local T = _G._GhostccThemeColor
            if T then
                card.BackgroundColor3 = T(Color3.fromRGB(12, 6, 25))
                local st = card:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
                if st then st.Color = T(Color3.fromRGB(149, 90, 255)) end
                local dv = card:FindFirstChild("Divider")
                if dv then dv.BackgroundColor3 = T(Color3.fromRGB(148, 86, 255)) end
                local sl = card:FindFirstChild("Slogan")
                if sl then
                    sl.TextColor3 = T(Color3.fromRGB(178, 122, 255))
                    sl.TextStrokeColor3 = T(Color3.fromRGB(25, 5, 50))
                end
                selfSpeedLabel.TextStrokeColor3 = T(Color3.fromRGB(30, 8, 60))
            end
        end
        for _, label in pairs(otherLabels) do
            if label and label.Parent then label.TextColor3 = c end
        end
    end
    if _G._GhostccAccent then pcall(_G._GhostccSetTagColor, _G._GhostccAccent) end
end)()

;(function()

    _G._GhostccFakeSpeed = tonumber(_G._GhostccFakeSpeed) or 16

    local HIJACK = _G._VelHijackStore
    if type(HIJACK) ~= "table" then
        HIJACK = { v = Vector3.zero }
        _G._VelHijackStore = HIJACK
    end
    HIJACK.v = Vector3.zero

    local LP = LocalPlayer

    if not _G._VelHijackInstalled then
        local ok = pcall(function()
            local _mt = getrawmetatable(game)
            setreadonly(_mt, false)
